# Round 49 (gh:#1897, #1902; children of #1216; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Match all upstream", and on #1897 "sure, go")

AI-written, not human-reviewed. Research, education and V&V only (`RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`). Written 2026-11-27.

## Part A (gh:#1897): what was read and found BEFORE the predictions (stated so the order is not hidden)

The task as filed was "make basic-lib's face centre/area routine a translation of OpenFOAM-ESI v2506's own". Read first: `primitiveMeshFaceCentresAndAreas.C` (only calls `primitiveMeshTools::makeFaceCentresAndAreas`), `primitiveMeshTools.C:204-262` (the routine), and `basicFvGeometryScheme.C` (`movePoints` calls `primitiveMesh::updateGeom`; `updateGeom(points, ...)` calls the same `makeFaceCentresAndAreas` then `makeCellCentresAndVols`; `weights()` uses `|Sf.(Cf-C_P)|` and `|Sf.(C_N-Cf)|`). The disassembly of the shipped `libOpenFOAM.so` routine (`objdump`: 0 fused multiply-add; SSE2 packed `mulpd/subpd/addpd`, `divpd` by `n`) shows the same arithmetic as basic-lib's `io::face_centre_and_area`: `fCentre = (sum of points) / n`, `n = (next - this) ^ (fCentre - this)`, `a = sqrt((nx^2 + ny^2) + nz^2)`, `c = (this + next) + fCentre`, `sumAc += a c`, `(1/3) sumAc / sumA`, `0.5 sumN`.

Measured (probe `upstream_driver/dump_face_geometry_r49/`, built on the shipped OpenFOAM, `moving 0`, `recompute-differs 0`; the MSFR neutronics mesh of round 43 read from the committed `cases/msfr_neutro/polyMesh`):

1. A Python transcription of the routine in IEEE double (no FMA) gives upstream's `Sf` on **all 34 578 faces, bit for bit**.
2. basic-lib's `face_centre_and_area` on upstream's own points (dumped `%.17g`) gives upstream's `Sf` and `Cf` on **all 34 578 faces, bit for bit**. The face routine was never the defect; the "documented as operation for operation" claim was true.
3. The round-43 refs (`Sf`, `Cf`, `C`, `w`) equal this probe's output exactly, so the reference is the same geometry.
4. **The cause is the points.** 4 of 52 860 coordinates (points 6897, 7886, 15689, 16678, the `z` of vertices of the 8 symmetric quads) are read by upstream one ulp BELOW the correctly rounded value: file text `0.8417393185` is `0.84173931849999994` in OpenFOAM and `0.8417393185` in Rust's `str::parse::<f64>`. ESI's `readDouble` is `::strtold` narrowed to `double` (`doubleScalar.C`: "convert using larger representation to properly capture underflow"), i.e. a DOUBLE rounding through the x87 80-bit type: decimal to a 64-bit significand, then to 53 bits. `appbuilder::parse_points` (`t.parse::<f64>()`) fed the routine a different input. Round 43's reading ("basic-lib's routine differs from upstream's") put the cause in the wrong place; its measurements (which faces, which size) were right.

**Change.** `outram_foam_basic_lib::io::parse_foam_f64` (new, `src/io/foam_number.rs`; integer arithmetic only, so no_std/wasm/Android give the same bits): a decimal is converted to the 64-bit-significand value (nearest-even, exact big-integer quotient with sticky bit) and then to 53 bits (nearest-even). Used by basic-lib's `read_points` and `appbuilder::parse_points`. `face_centre_and_area` is unchanged (nothing to translate; no kovan review stamp in `src/io/`, re-checked: its `review.md` holds a `kind = "note"` only). Check against the real `strtold`: 10^6 pseudo-random decimal strings, **0 mismatches**; `strtold` differs from `str::parse` in 149 of them (`tests/foam_number_vs_strtold.rs` embeds the 149 and 120 others; generator `upstream_driver/strtold_ref/strtold_ref.cpp`). After the change `read_poly_mesh` gives `Sf` equal to upstream's on **0 differing of 34 578 faces** (before: 8 faces).

Not changed here, listed on purpose: the field-value and dictionary number readers (`appbuilder::io::field_reader` 4 sites, basic-lib `io::dict` 3 sites, `io::field` 1 site) still use `str::parse`. It is the same one-line change, but every recorded pin that reads a field or dictionary number would be re-measured; see the results for what was done.

A pin may move for round-off by up to 1e-9 relative (direct) or 1e-4 (propagated), recorded old/new where it lives; beyond that, or unexplained, stop and report. No gate is loosened. A gate is tightened only to a value the post-run measurement supports and only where the result is bit-identical.

**FINDING that corrected an earlier decision in this round: `PolyMesh::read` (basic-lib) keeps the correctly rounded parse.** With `parse_foam_f64` in basic-lib's `read_points` as well, `outram-foam-cli/tests/cfmesh_vs_upstream_stages::asmo_octree_cartesian_mesh_stages` failed ("asmoOctree after edgeExtraction must be bit-identical": 6 of 49 829 points one ulp from the port's, e.g. point 7224 `z` port -0.022433088581934352, upstream-as-read -0.02243308858193435). The committed cfMesh stage meshes are 16-digit dumps of IN-MEMORY values, and a 16-digit text can sit within a double-rounding of a midpoint, so reading them the ESI way gives the value upstream would hold if it re-READ its own file, not the value it held in memory. Reading a polyMesh the ESI way is right when the question is "what does upstream hold after reading this file" (GeN-Foam's case, round 43) and wrong when the file is a lossy dump compared with a port's in-memory result. `PolyMesh::read` therefore stays as it was (re-run: 9 of 9 pass); `parse_foam_f64` is an explicit choice (`read_poly_mesh` in appbuilder). Decision for the maintainer, filed.

**Radial-power gate (`genfoam_radial_power_wired_vs_upstream`, `lumped_nuclear_structure_matches` and `_three_nodes_matches`): FAILS after the parser change, gate NOT loosened.** The gate `worst_residual <= 1e-6` is the relative difference of INITIAL linear residuals of solves whose upstream residual is above 1e-7, i.e. a noise-limited quantity (field differences of ~1e-12 over an initial residual of ~1e-7). Before: 8.6e-7 (lns), 8.4e-7 (lns3) (14 % under the gate); after the parser change: 2.5e-6, 1.8e-6; with the cell-centred helper change on top: 5.3e-7, 2.0e-6. `bit-equal` counts 5653 to 5645 (lns), 6088 to 6122 (lns3). Everything else of the test holds (outer iterations equal, worst iteration difference 1, worst field 5.8e-10 and 1.6e-11 under the 1e-9 gate). The geometry (4 coordinates of the staged mesh) is closer to upstream's, and a noise-limited residual comparison landed on the other side of its gate: the explained, bounded cause, not an unexplained move. Decision needed (gh filed): the gate measures noise, it cannot be met by construction; I did not move it.

Movement is mixed in sign, as expected of a partial change (the matrix assembly, `fvMatrix::relax`, `reconstruct`, `dev2_div` are still the old forms and inside `fv.rs` `interp_linear` is still called by other operators): `genfoam_msfr_th_vs_upstream` step 1 `p` 2.9e-13 to 1.4e-13, step 2 1.2e-13 to 1.5e-13, step 3 5.9e-14 to 3.0e-13 (round-off, worse at step 3), `U` step 1 9.0e-12 to 5.8e-12. Prediction B3 ("every worst case falls"): **missed**; nothing becomes bit-identical until B4 is done, so no gate is tightened.

**Not done, filed:** B4 (matrix assembly keeping `D` and per-face internal/boundary coefficients apart in the cell-centred and two-phase energy/pressure equations, `fvMatrix::relax` per component, `reconstruct` by `Tensor::safeInv`, `dev2_div` interpolation), the neutronics / multi-region / thermo-mechanics regions (they run on basic-lib's `fvm`/`fvc`, whose weights and interpolation are already upstream's operation order: `operators_vs_openfoam` is bit-identical, round 40 onwards, so there was nothing to switch), and the outer-3 `T`/`rho` 1-ulp of `1D_HX/onePhase` (not started).

# Round 52 (gh:#1903, child of #1216/#1895; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Match all upstream"; on #1903: "3D MSFR or ESFR"): the heat-exchanger zone-to-zone WEIGHTED mapping in the cell-centred `onePhase` region, on a 3-D mesh

AI-written, not human-reviewed. Research, education and V&V only (`RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`). Written 2026-11-27. **Predictions and every comparison criterion below are committed BEFORE the first upstream run and BEFORE the first port run of this round's case.**

## Checked first (what exists, what the shipped cases say)

* **3-D cases shipped under `Tutorials/`**: `3D_SmallESFR_NewSolverVerification` (`newSolver`, `legacySolver`), `3D_SmallESFR_old`, `3D_gFHR`, `3D_HTR-10`, `3D_NTPfuelAssembly`; **no 3-D MSFR**. `grep -rl heatExchangers Tutorials/` finds only `featureCases/1D_HX/{onePhase,twoPhase}` and `reactorCases/2D_FFTF` (its `phaseProperties`, two-phase). **The shipped `3D_SmallESFR` fluidRegion has NO `heatExchangers` block** (its `phaseProperties` carries only `structureProperties` zones, `regimeMapModels`, drag and Nusselt models), so there is no shipped 3-D exchanger to use; a documented variant is needed.
* **What the cell-centred region ports**: `thermoType` `heRhoThermo`/`hConst`/`Boussinesq` only, `heatTransferModels` `constant` only, velocity `wedge`/`fixedValue`, `p_rgh` `fixedFluxPressure`/`wedge`, `T` `zeroGradient`/`wedge`. The shipped ESFR fluid region selects polynomial thermo, `byRegime` Nusselt models, `slip` walls, an open inlet/outlet (`fixedValue` `T`, `fixedFluxExtrapolatedPressure`) and `nuclearFuelPinTest`: **all refused by name in `one_phase_cc`**, as before this round. Porting them is not needed to test the mapping and is NOT done here.
* **Zones of the shipped ESFR mesh** (volumes of the 23322-cell mesh, computed from the polyMesh): `axialReflector` 4.2369, `controlRod` 0.2840, `radialReflector` 3.2490, `innerCore` 2.1167, `follower` 1.1084, `outerCore` 2.0783, `diagrid` 1.9512 m^3 (total 15.0246). `innerCore` and `outerCore` pass upstream's SIGNED volume check as (primary `outerCore`, secondary `innerCore`) (`(pV - sV)/pV` = -1.8 %) but their centres of volume are IDENTICAL (`(0, 0, 1.4)`, concentric): the translation is zero and the mapping the identity, so the shipped zones cannot test a weighted mapping. Hence two added zones.
* **Searched (reuse)**: `cases/mesh_deform_esfr` (the same ESFR fluid mesh, no zones), `msfr_th` (the cell-centred settings), `make_msfr_th_hx_two_zones.py` (round 46's split rule), `multi_region::cell_overlap` (round 28, bit-identical `meshToMesh`), `HeatExchangerSet` (round 44, reused unchanged), `upstream_driver/mesh_to_mesh_dump`. Not found: a 3-D cell-centred exchanger case, a dump of the weights of the exchanger's own mapping.

## The case `cases/esfr_hx` (made by `scripts/make_esfr_hx_case.py`; every choice below is an input, none chosen after a result)

* **Mesh**: the shipped `3D_SmallESFR_NewSolverVerification/newSolver` fluidRegion mesh as it is (points, faces, owner, neighbour, `boundary` with the `mappedWall` baffle patches): 3-D hexahedral, assemblies separated by baffles, so a translated copy overlaps itself in all three directions.
* **Zones**: `hxA` and `hxB` are the two halves of the core (`innerCore` + `outerCore`, 6540 cells): cells ordered by `(round(x,6), round(y,6), round(z,6))` of the cell centre, cut where the two volumes balance best (the round 46 rule); `hxA` = first part (3270 cells each, volumes equal to 1e-15). The shipped zones stay in `cellZones`. Upstream's text says the zones may be arbitrary cell sets of equal volume, "non-conformal" meshes included, with "any relative displacement". **A priori fallback, fixed now**: if the mapping of this split is conformal or empty (fewer than 50 % of the primary cells with two or more entries), the sort key is changed to `(y, x, z)` and then `(z, x, y)`, in that order, every attempt reported; the case is never altered by any other number.
* **Physics settings** = the `2D_MSFR` `steadyStateTH` settings of rounds 17-37 (`thermophysicalProperties` Boussinesq `rho0 4125`, `T0 900`, `beta 2e-4`, `Cp 1600`, `mu 0.01`, `Pr 8`; `g = (0 0 -9.81)`; `fvSchemes`; tight `fvSolution`; `PIMPLE` 5 outer x 6 correctors; `controlDict` with `adjustTimeStep`, `maxCo 5`, 1e-3 s first step; `turbulence false`), because those are the only ones the region ports. **Named deviations from the shipped ESFR files**: thermo and closures replaced by the MSFR ones; `U` `fixedValue (0 0 0)` on all five patches (the shipped `slip`/open patches are refused), `p_rgh` `fixedFluxPressure`, `T` `zeroGradient`: a CLOSED cavity; neutronics and mechanics regions removed (fluid region alone), the coupling fields absent (no nuclear heating); GAMG replaced by PCG/DIC and tolerances 1e-14, relTol 0 (round 18's protocol). Structure: the core zones `hxA:hxB` `volumeFraction 0.6`, `Dh 0.01`, drag `ReynoldsPower 0.5 -0.25`, `heatTransferModels constant 1e4` (the MSFR `hx` zone); the other zones `volumeFraction 0`; a pump `momentumSource (0 0 3e5)` in `diagrid` (the MSFR's magnitude, upward) so the flow is not zero; no fixed-temperature structure (no heat source).
* **Initial temperature** (so the exchangers have a driving difference; a nonuniform `T` read from disk, which upstream allows): `T = 900 K` everywhere except `hxB` cells at `800 K`.
* **Exchangers** (the two of `1D_HX`, mirrored): `ABHX` primary `hxA` secondary `hxB`, `BAHX` primary `hxB` secondary `hxA`; `volumetricArea 250`, `wallConductance 2.5e4` (the shipped 1D_HX values, as rounds 44 and 46). Two exchangers test the mapping with `delta` and `-delta`.
* **Protocol**: round 44 part 2: `scripts/run_esfr_hx_tight.sh` (the real unmodified binary, serial), three steps (`END_TIME 0.0037`), every step written at `writePrecision 17`.
* **References** `refs/esfr_hx_r52.ref.txt.gz`: every 11th cell of `U p_rgh T` (whole mesh), every 7th core cell (`hxA` then `hxB`) of `T`, `T.HX`, `htc`, every `p_rgh` and `h` solve; `refs/esfr_hx_r52_mapping.ref.txt.gz`: the addressing and normalised weights of both exchangers (below).

## Mapping probe (what "upstream's weights" means here)

`upstream_driver/hx_mapping_dump/hxMappingDump.C` builds, with OpenFOAM-ESI v2506's own classes, what `heatExchanger::constructSecondaryHX` builds (`heatExchanger.C:310-431`): the volume-weighted centres of the two zones (the same loops over `V()` and `C()`), `delta`, the translated copy of the whole mesh (`points + delta`, same faces and cells), and `meshToMesh(translated, mesh, imCellVolumeWeight, pmAABB, false)`; it dumps `tgtToSrcCellAddr` and `tgtToSrcCellWght` of the primary cells at 17 digits, and `delta`. It is NOT the instrumented binary: its `delta` is compared with the `Heat exchanger ... mapping: applied translation of` log lines of the real binary (17 digits). The end-to-end comparison below (`T.HX`, `T`) is what checks that the binary's own mapping equals the probe's.

## Comparison criteria (fixed here; none will change after seeing results)

* **Mapping (port vs probe)**, per exchanger and primary cell: the number of entries, the source labels in order, the normalised weights. Gate: counts and labels identical; weights `<= 1e-9` relative, expected bit-identical (round 28); `delta` bit-identical to the log. Reported: primary cells with 1 / 2 / 3+ entries, share fractional, weight sums within 4 ulp, worst weight difference.
* **Per step (1, 2, 3)**, as round 44 part 2: the outer-iteration count of each step equal; the iteration count of every `p_rgh` and `h` solve within 1 for upstream initial residuals above `1e-10`; fields `U`, `p_rgh`, `T` (every 11th cell), core-zone `T`, `T.HX`, `htc` (every 7th core cell): `max|port - up|/max|up| <= 1e-9` on each field's own maximum; `T` in `hxA` and in `hxB` reported separately (absolute `max|dT|` in K printed). **Exchanged heat** `Q = iAHX*H*(THX - T)` [W/m^3] per sampled core cell from each code's `T.HX`, `T`, `htc`: `<= 1e-9` on its own maximum; the sampled sum of `Q` per zone, relative `<= 1e-9`. First diverging step (above 1e-9) and the worst field reported.
* **Flow fields**: `U`, `p_rgh` compared every step (the pump drives `U`; its size is printed).
* Bit-identity is the goal; a round-off allowance (`<= 1e-9`) needs an explained cause. A solve-log violation is reported, not hidden; solves below `1e-10` initial residual are not count-gated (round 44 floor).

### Predictions: held and missed

E1 held. E2 held (79-80 % against the 50 % gate; my 65 % was a correct direction). E3 held (bit-identical). **E4 MISSED:** the port refused the case by name on the first read (`T` has a `nonuniform` internal field, which `read_field` accepted for `alpha.<fluid>` only); a one-function change, no number moved: `case::read_field_bcs_only` (takes the BOUNDARY conditions of `T`; the internal field is read by `read_vol_scalar_field`, which already accepted `nonuniform`), used by `one_phase_cc/flow.rs`. E5 held. E6 held (7.1e-11 against 1e-9; expected 1e-12..1e-11: `U` is slightly above the expected range, by the round-off explained above). E7 held for `T.HX <= 1e-11` (7.6e-16), the bit-identical part (P 25 %) MISSED (not bit-identical; `htc` is). **E8 MISSED, by an arithmetic error of mine:** I predicted about -16 K per step; the source `250 x 1e4 x (858 - 900) = -1.05e8` W/m^3 times 1e-3 s over `alpha rho Cp = 0.4 x 4125 x 1600 = 2.64e6` J/(m^3 K) is **-0.040 K** per step (I divided by `rho Cp` and slipped three orders of magnitude). The case is therefore much weaker than I intended (0.04 K to 0.14 K of exchange against 100 K of driving difference); it still tests the mapping at the 1e-9 gate, because the weights enter `THX` (a 42 K signal in `T.HX`) and `Q`, and the nearest-cell control shows `T.HX` at 4.6e-2, but `T` itself discriminates only at 1.6e-4 (C1). A stronger exchange (a larger `volumetricArea` or `wallConductance`) was NOT tried: the inputs are the shipped 1D_HX values and were fixed before the run. C1 MISSED because of E8; C2, C3 held. M1 held (below). W1 held (upstream 6 s, port 18 s per run).

### Deviations and things done after the first upstream run (stated, not hidden)

* **The first upstream run aborted** (`Invalid wall function specification: Patch type for patch top must be wall`): the committed case had `nutkWallFunction` (`nut`), `kqRWallFunction` (`k`), `epsilonWallFunction` (`epsilon`) on the ESFR patches `top`, `bottom`, `walls` (type `patch`). Fixed BEFORE any reference was taken: `nut` `calculated` (value 0.1, as the MSFR files), `k` and `epsilon` `zeroGradient`. With `turbulence false` the wall functions do not act, so no number depends on it; this is a deviation from the MSFR files beyond those listed in the case description above, in `make_esfr_hx_case.py` (committed after the predictions).
* The pump (`diagrid`, `momentumSource (0 0 3e5)`) drives a flow of only about 1e-4 m/s in 3 steps (Courant number about 1e-6): the baffled assemblies are closed and the forcing acts for 3.6 ms. The flow fields (`U`, `p_rgh`) are compared as committed (7.1e-11, 1.1e-12) but they are small; this is a weak test of the flow solver and a good one of the mapping.
* `hxMappingDump` is not the instrumented binary (stated in the criteria); the binary's own mapping is validated through `T.HX`, `T` and `Q`, which depend on it and agree to 8e-16.
* Not done: `secondaryRegion` (gh:#1904); a 3-D MSFR (not shipped); the shipped ESFR's own physics (polynomial thermo, `byRegime` Nusselt, open boundaries, `slip`, `nuclearFuelPinTest`) in `one_phase_cc`: refused by name, unchanged.

### Moved numbers and reproduction

None moved: the one source edit (`read_field_bcs_only`, used only by `one_phase_cc/flow.rs` for `T`) changes behaviour only for a case with a nonuniform `T`, which was refused before. Regression run (private target, release): see "Tests run" in the hand-off; results below. Reproduction: `python3 -I scripts/make_esfr_hx_case.py` (case), `bash scripts/run_esfr_hx_tight.sh r52`, `python3 -I scripts/extract_esfr_hx_reference.py <run> cases/esfr_hx/constant/fluidRegion/polyMesh/cellZones.gz <out>` + `scripts/extract_msfr_th_log.sh` appended, `bash scripts/build_and_run_hx_mapping_dump.sh <out>` (every 4th primary cell kept for the reference), `cargo test --release -p outram-foam-appbuilder-lib --test genfoam_heat_exchanger_3d_vs_upstream -- --nocapture --test-threads=1`.

# Round 53 (gh:#1909 item 5, readers; child of #1216; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Match all upstream"; on #1909: "(1) YES, switch the field and dictionary number readers to `parse_foam_f64`"; "(3) basic-lib `PolyMesh::read` keeps the correctly rounded parse")

## What was read before the predictions

Sites that read a decimal into `f64` from an OpenFOAM case text file, found by grepping `parse::<f64>`, `.parse()` into a typed `f64`, `from_str` in `outram-foam-appbuilder-lib/src` and `outram-foam-basic-lib/src`:

| # | site | what it reads | shared with |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1-4 | `appbuilder::io::field_reader` `parse_uniform_scalar`, nonuniform scalar list, `parse_vector_triple`, `parse_uniform_scalar_payload` | `0/<field>` internalField and boundary values | GeN-Foam and the appbuilder solvers |
| 5-7 | basic-lib `io::dict` `parse_dimensioned` exponents, `parse_leaf` (2 sites) | every dictionary number (fvSolution, fvSchemes, controlDict, thermophysicalProperties, nuclearData, structureProperties, phaseProperties, multiRegionCouplingDict, cellZones/time tables through `FoamFile`) | cfMesh port, `outram-foam-mesh`, `outram-foam-cli`, kovan-literature: they write then read their own files (round-trip tests), so the default stays correctly rounded |
| 8 | basic-lib `io::field` `parse_f64` | `read_vol_scalar_field` / `read_vol_vector_field` (`FoamCase::read`) | same sharing |
| extra | `two_phase/one_phase_cc.rs` `parse_value` (uniform and nonuniform scalar lists of the cell-centred reader), `workflow/allrun.rs` `uniform_internal_field`, `workflow/reactor_state.rs` (`keff`, `pTarget`), `neutronics/diffusion/external_source_case.rs` `parse_scalar` | GeN-Foam case files | GeN-Foam only |

Not switched, on purpose: `PolyMesh::read` (decision 3); `view_factor_radiation` (OpenFOAM's `viewFactor` reads `F` with `readList<scalar>`, but no GeN-Foam test uses it; listed, not changed); the CSV readers of the HTR-10 example (`fpic.rs`, `power_map.rs`: not OpenFOAM files); `upstream_differential.rs` (reads `%.17g` dumps printed by the real class from a double).

**Design.** The shared basic-lib readers keep the correctly rounded default and gain explicit ESI entry points (`FoamFile::parse_esi`, `parse_named_esi`, `read_esi`, `read_with_includes_esi`, `read_vol_scalar_field_esi`, `read_vol_vector_field_esi`), so cfMesh, `outram-foam-mesh` and the CLI are unchanged and a write-then-read round trip of this workspace's shortest-round-trip text stays exact (strtold can differ from it by one ulp). Every GeN-Foam call site of the appbuilder switches to the ESI entry points; `appbuilder::io::field_reader` switches directly.

## Predictions (written BEFORE the switch; committed first)

A decimal of at most ~12 significant digits is rounded differently by `strtold`-then-narrow only when the 64-bit intermediate lands on a 53-bit midpoint: about 1 in 10^3 to 10^4 for 10-digit values (round 49: 4 of 52 860 point coordinates), and almost never for hand-typed short decimals (`0.5`, `1e5`, `300`).

| id | prediction | confidence |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | Tests whose input numbers are hand-typed short decimals do not move at all (bit-identical to before) | 85 % |
| R2 | Tests that read machine-written fields with 6 to 17 digits (the MSFR/ESFR `0/` files written by OpenFOAM, `nonuniform` lists) read 1-ulp different values in about 1 of 10^3 to 10^4 of them; the tests that read them (`genfoam_msfr_transient_vs_upstream`, `_chain_`, `_th_`, `genfoam_heat_exchanger_*`) move by round-off: no recorded value moves by more than 1e-9 relative directly or 1e-4 propagated | 75 % |
| R3 | `genfoam_msfr_precursor_matrix_vs_upstream` (all-zero gates, round 49) stays bit-identical; if a field it reads moves, it moves towards upstream, not away | 85 % |
| R4 | At least one non-bit-identical vs-upstream gate becomes bit-identical or its worst difference falls; at least one worst difference rises by round-off (mixed signs, as round 49 B3, since matrix assembly B4 is still the old form) | 60 % |
| R5 | The noise-limited radial-power gates (`lumped_nuclear_structure_matches`, `_three_nodes_matches`; README round 49: 1.8e-6 .. 2.5e-6 against a 1e-6 gate) move again by noise; they pass or fail with equal probability and are NOT loosened | 50 % |
| R6 | Counting numeric tokens of the shipped GeN-Foam case files: the fraction whose ESI value differs from the correctly rounded one is below 1e-3 overall and 0 for files with at most 8 significant digits | 80 % |
| R7 | basic-lib and appbuilder-lib `--lib --tests`: no failure caused by the readers other than R5 | 85 % |
| R8 | `outram-foam-cli`, `outram-foam-mesh`, `outram-park-fork-cfmesh` tests unchanged (default entry points) | 95 % |

Criteria (fixed here): a pin may move for round-off by up to 1e-9 relative (direct) or 1e-4 (propagated), recorded old/new where it lives; beyond that, or unexplained, STOP and report. No gate is loosened. A gate is tightened only to a value the post-run measurement supports and only where the result is bit-identical.

# Round 54 (coupled tutorials end to end; gh:#1879 "U go couple lah", children of #1216): the requirements table, and the choice of tutorial

AI-written, not human-reviewed. Research, education and V&V only (`RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`). Written 2026-11-27. Maintainer: "Port genfoam exhaustively", "Match all upstream", and on #1879 "U go couple lah". This section is the requirements table committed BEFORE any piece is ported; pieces and their differentials follow below it as they land (none had landed at the time of this commit: see "Status").

## 1D_thermalMSR_pointKinetics: skipped, by the maintainer's own deferral

`system/controlDict:50` of the shipped case reads `liquidFuel true` and `nuclearData:77` `initPrecursorsLiquidFuel true`; its fuel circulates through a cold leg, hot leg, `hx` and `pump` loop. That is the cyclic liquid-fuel coupled path of gh:#1905, DEFERRED by the maintainer. Not done.

## A fact found first that changes what "against the real binary" means for `2D_fullCoupling`

The built `GeN-Foam` binary (652b3da on ESI v2506) lists only `SNNeutronics SP3Neutronics adjointDiffusionNeutronics diffusionNeutronics multiPhysicsSolver onePhase pointKinetics twoPhase` as solvers; the shipped case's `thermoMechanicalRegion` aborts with `Unknown solver of type: legacyThermoMechanics` (measured 2026-11-27). The TM library of rounds 23-27 (`/home/user/upstream-build/gh1781/lib/libThermoMechanicsSolvers.so`: upstream's unmodified `legacyThermoMechanics` and `GFTractionDisplacement` sources, `Make/options` without offbeat) fixes that when loaded with `libs ("libThermoMechanicsSolvers.so");` in `controlDict` and `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`: the REAL executable then runs the shipped steady state (Allrun's `setSteadyState`, edits by sed: `/home/user/upstream-build/gh1912/run_ss.sh`) in **5 s, 476 steps to t = 100** (first `deltaT` 1, then 0.2084211, ...), each step "Solving physics once": map, then per region `deformMesh()` + `correctPhysics()` (GAMG `p_rgh`, `diagonalPBiCGStab` `h`, 3 PIMPLE correctors, neutronics with `keff_` 0.625 at step 1, 3 thermoMechanical iterations, `fuelDisp`). So the reference for this tutorial is cheap and exists. The shipped fluid region is `laminar`, 144 cells; neutro 432 cells; the tutorial has three regions.

## Comparison criteria (fixed here; none will change after seeing results)

1. **Readable and runnable**: `OnePhaseCcSolver::from_case_dir` accepts the staged case, no refusal. (Pinned negatively by `tests/genfoam_coupled_tutorials_requirements.rs`, which is updated as rows close.)
2. **Fields, every extracted step** (1-100, every 10th, last): `U`, `p`, `p_rgh`, `T`, `alphaPhi` (internal faces), `htc`, `T.passiveStructure`, `T.fuelAvForNeutronics`: `max|port - up| / max|up| <= 1e-9` on each field's own max-norm. `U` is gated on `max|U|` over all components and ALSO reported per component (`Ux`, `Uy`, `Uz`; here `Uz` carries the flow, `Ux` is the small lateral part). **First diverging step** (any field above 1e-9) and the worst field reported. Bit-identity is the goal; `<= 1e-9` needs an explained cause.
3. **Time-step sequence**: the port's own `adjust_delta_t` sequence equals upstream's `deltaT` of each step to `1e-14` relative, for all 476 steps; the step count to `t = 100` equal (476).
4. **Solve log, every step, every outer iteration**: `p_rgh` solves with upstream initial residual above `1e-10`: initial residual to `1e-6` relative and iteration count within 1; solves starting at or below `1e-10` (the round-off floor of the previous solve's tail, round 19) are REPORTED, not gated (maintainer 2026-11-27: noise-floor iteration counts reported, not gated). `h` solves: the same rule (floor `1e-10`). `T (avg min max)` of every outer iteration: `1e-9` relative to its own value.
5. **Controls per piece**, each against the real binary on the same staged case with ONE edit (made by `scripts/make_fullcoupling_fluid_variants.sh`, first 20 steps, gates 2-4): **V1** `passiveProperties` removed (isolates the passive structure); **V2** `NusseltReynoldsPrandtlPower` replaced by `constant` `value 25000` (isolates the Nusselt `htc`); **V3** an explicit `h { solver smoothSolver; smoother symGaussSeidel; tolerance 1e-14; relTol 0; }` entry AFTER the catch-all (isolates the translated `smoothSolver`/`symGaussSeidelSmoother`: the one place it is selected). Port ablations (not upstream behaviours): **A1** passive structure ignored (`without_passive_structure`), **A2** `htc` frozen at its first value; each must move `T` by `>= 1e-6` of `max T` within 20 steps, else the case "tests less than intended".
6. **Earlier numbers (rounds 3-52) do not move**: `genfoam_msfr_th_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_msfr_th_options_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_msfr_th_pimple_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_msfr_th_nonorth_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_heat_exchanger_cc_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_msfr_coupled_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_radial_power_cc_vs_upstream` and `--lib one_phase` run in the PRIVATE target dir; any number that moves is listed with old and new (rounding rule: 1e-9 direct, 1e-4 propagated). The one source change that can move them is the energy matrix keeping `internalCoeffs`/`boundaryCoeffs` apart as `fvMatrix` does (formerly folded into the diagonal and the source at assembly): upstream's form, adopted because the inlet `fixedValue` `he` patch needs it; **expected effect on the wedge cases: below 1e-9** (the boundary flux of a wedge face is ~1e-11 of the diagonal).

AI-written, not human-reviewed. What was ported (each line cites the upstream function; the code is in `one_phase_cc.rs`, `one_phase_cc/flow.rs`):

* **`laminar`** (`laminarModel::New` -> `Stokes`: `nut() = 0`, `nuEff() = nu()`; `ThermalDiffusivity::alphat()` a zero field): no `nut`/`alphat` file is read; a `laminar { model ...; }` sub-dictionary is refused by name.
* **Thermo** (`fluid.C:464-510`, `fluid::rho(bool)`, `heRhoThermo::calculate`, `heThermo::kappa/alphaEff`, `polynomialTransport::alphah = kappa/Cp`): `OnePhaseCcCase::thermo` is a `PhaseThermo` (the stack of `two_phase/thermo.rs`, reused unchanged, plus the existing Boussinesq arm); `fluid::rho()` is a per-cell and per-boundary-face field (`rho0` for Boussinesq, `rho(p, T)` otherwise) with an old-time copy; `Cp`, `kappa = Cp alpha`, `Pr = Cp mu/kappa` are the lagging placeholder fields of `fluid.C`/`EEqn_1p.H`; `T` from `he` by `PhaseThermo::t_from_he` (Newton, `Ttol = T0 1e-4`).
* **`NusseltReynoldsPrandtlPower`** (`NusseltFSHeatTransferCoefficient::value`): `FsHtcModel::Nusselt` calls the existing closure with the lagging `Pr`, `kappa` fields and `Re` of the current `correctModels`.
* **`passiveProperties`** (`structure.C:372-475`, `1020-1055`, `1122-1124`): `iApas`, `alphaRhoCp = max(alphapas rhoCp, 1e-69)`, `Tpas`; the passive terms of `linearizedSemiImplicitHeatSource` added as upstream's `(S - Sp) + S - Sp` sum; the explicit `Tpas` update from `HT = Hs T.prevIter()` and `Tpas.oldTime()`.
* **Boundary conditions** (`fluid.C` phi types, `fixedEnergy`/`gradientEnergy`): `U` `fixedValue`/`zeroGradient`/`slip`, `T` `fixedValue`/`zeroGradient`, `p_rgh` `fixedValue` (with `needReference()` false: no `setReference`), `empty`; the `he` patches follow `T`'s.
* **The energy matrix keeps `internalCoeffs`/`boundaryCoeffs` apart** as `fvMatrix` does (added to the diagonal and the source at the solve; `relax` as `fvMatrix::relax`): the inlet `fixedValue` `he` patch needs it. `min(T)`/`max(T)` now run over the boundary faces too (upstream's `T (avg min max)` line).
* **`h` solvers**: `HSolver::{PBiCGStabDiagonal, SmoothSymGaussSeidel}` chosen by the exact keyword, else the last matching pattern. **No new smoother was written**: `one_phase::smooth_solve_sym_gauss_seidel_openfoam` (round 46, ESI v2506 `smoothSolver.C`/`symGaussSeidelSmoother.C`, differenced in the face-centred region) is reused; `relTol != 0`, `nSweeps != 1`, `maxIter != 1000` are refused by name.
* Refused by name, not ported: a compressible equation of state (`psi != 0`), RAS `turbulence true` with a non-Boussinesq thermo, `expTc != 0`, a `laminar` model other than `Stokes`, any `U`/`T`/`p_rgh` patch type other than those above.

### Why not bit-identical, and what was not localised

`p_rgh` and `p` agree to 4e-14 and `U` to 2e-13 from step 1 (`p_rgh` PCG/`DIC` solved to `1e-14`: a normalised residual of 1e-14 leaves a solution error of that order times the condition number of the Poisson matrix, so a last-digit difference anywhere upstream of the solve appears as ~1e-13 in `U` and `alphaPhi`, not in `T`). The cause was NOT localised to an operation (candidates: `petir` `r_powf` against glibc `pow` in `htc` and `ReynoldsPower` (1 ulp, accepted and pinned elsewhere), the order of the summed boundary coefficients). No bisection against intermediate upstream values was made; no value was tuned.

### Controls and the one thing that did move

* `scripts/make_fullcoupling_fluid_variants.sh` + `run_fullcoupling_fluid_variants.sh` make V1-V3 and their references (real binary, 20 steps each).
* Findings recorded in the issue: the shipped `smoothSolver` `h` entry is shadowed (above); `removeBaffles fluidRegion true` of the shipped file is a no-op for this mesh (no baffle patch) and was set `false` in the fluid-only case.

# Round 56 (gh:#1856 items 1, 2, 5; unblocks #1914 stage B and #1846; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Port genfoam exhaustively", "Match all upstream", "U go couple lah"): the neutronics region on the deforming mesh, against the real coupled binary

AI-written, not human-reviewed. Research, education and V&V only (`RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`). Written 2026-11-27. **Predictions and every criterion below are committed BEFORE the first comparison of the port with the real binary's output of this round.** The real binary was run first (reference `refs/fc_coupled_r56.ref.txt.gz`, 4.0 MB; its LOG lines, `disp` and the first-step `meshPhi` were looked at to design the extraction; no port number has been looked at).

## What was read before the predictions (upstream, 652b3da / ESI v2506)

* **Which equations see mesh motion.** `deformMesh()` exists in `neutronics.C:363`, `thermalHydraulicsModel.C:380` and `thermoMechanics.C:353` (the same five lines) and is called for every solver in `multiPhysicsSolver::correctPhysics` (`multiPhysicsSolver.C:176`, every Picard iteration, BEFORE the solver's `correctPhysics()`). GeN-Foam reads `meshPhi`/`V0`/`V00` nowhere (no `makeRelative`/`makeAbsolute`/`meshPhi` in `src/` except the `mesh.moving()` tests of `myMULES`); the only consumer is OpenFOAM's `EulerDdtScheme`. The `ddt` terms in GeN-Foam: neutronics `createFluxMatrices.H:21` `fvm::ddt(vsf, fluxStar_)` and `precEq.H` `fvm::ddt(alpha(1-eig), precStar)` / `fvm::ddt((1-eig), prec)` (SN/SP3 likewise, not ported here); onePhase `EEqn_1p.H:18` `fvm::ddt(alpha, rho, he)`, `:44` `fvc::ddt(p)`, `:53` `fvc::ddt(alpha, rho, K)`, `UEqn_1p.H:57` `fvm::ddt(alpha, rho, U)`, `calcrAUf...:29,31` `fvc::ddt(alpha)`, `fvm::ddt(p_rgh)`, `onePhase.C:246` `fvc::ddt(fluid_, rho)`; structure `structure.C:1027` `fvm::ddt(alphaRhoCppas, Tpas)`; thermo-mechanics `solveThermalMechanics.H:65` `fvm::ddt(rhoC, TStruct)`.
* **In the shipped `2D_fullCoupling` only `neutroRegion` is listed in `meshDeformation`**; the steady state runs `eigenvalueNeutronics true`, so every neutronics `ddt` coefficient is `(1 - 1) = 0`: the moving-mesh ddt contributes exactly zero there, and the mesh motion enters the neutronics only through the GEOMETRY (`V`, `Sf`, `nonOrthDeltaCoeffs`, `nonOrthCorrectionVectors`, interpolation weights; `laplacianSchemes Gauss linear corrected`) and `power()` (`domainIntegrate`, `V`). The cross sections are constant (`xsVariables {}`), so the fluid and mechanics do not enter the neutronics at all except through `disp`.
* **`volPointInterpolation` on a 2D mesh** (ESI `volPointInterpolation.C:67-129, 153-205`): an `empty` patch is NOT a patch (`isA<emptyPolyPatch>`): its faces are not `boundaryIsPatchFace_` and a point on empty faces only is not an `isPatchPoint_`; it is interpolated from its cells like an interior point. `emptyPointPatch` is excluded from `pointConstraints::makePatchPatchAddressing` and `emptyPointPatchField` has no `evaluate`, so there is no constraint on the interpolated displacement. Round 26's port refused `empty` ("point constraints"); it is exactly this flag.
* **`meshPhi` old time (item 5).** `fvMesh::movePoints` (`fvMesh.C:927-934`) calls `phiPtr_->oldTime()` when `phiPtr_->timeIndex() != time().timeIndex()`; `setMeshPhi` then overwrites the field, whose non-const access runs `storeOldTimes()`. Net effect: `meshPhi.oldTime()` after a `movePoints` of step k is the `meshPhi` left by the last `movePoints` of the previous time index (before the first `movePoints` of step 1 there is none; a request made after the first move of step 1 creates a copy of the current field). Nothing in GeN-Foam or in `EulerDdtScheme` reads it (`backward` and `CrankNicolson` ddt, `ddtCorr` would): ported as state so a consumer has it, and tested against the real class by the round-30 probe.
* **Searched (reuse)**: `DeformableMesh::{move_points_at, deform_mesh_at, euler_fvm_ddt}` (round 30), `deform_region_mesh`, `correct_physics_loop_with_deformation`, `RegionMeshMap`, `pseudo_time::eigenvalue_time_step`, `fvm::laplacian_corrected`/`fvc::grad` (rounds 40/43), `expansion_from_displacement`, `euler_ddt` of `upstream_transient.rs` (static volumes), `upstream_stationary_step` (`NeutronicsLaplacianScheme::Corrected`, `NeutronicsDdtScheme::Euler`). Nothing of this round exists yet: the neutronics steps read the volumes from `state.mesh()` and have no rebinding to a moved mesh; the eigenvalue step has only the uncorrected laplacian; `MultiPhysicsSolver` regions own no mesh.

## The case `ss` (made by `scripts/make_fullcoupling_coupled_case.sh`, run by `scripts/run_fullcoupling_coupled.sh`; every choice an input)

The shipped `2D_fullCoupling` `steadyState` stage as Allrun sets it (`model diffusionNeutronics`, `eigenvalueNeutronics true`, `endTime 100`, `deltaT 1`, `multiRegionCouplingDict_steadyState`, `-initializeMappedFields`), with the tight protocol (every `tolerance 1e-14`, `relTol 0`, `p_rgh` GAMG -> PCG/DIC; the thermo-mechanics GAMG entries stay) and `writeControl timeStep`, `writeInterval 1`, `writePrecision 17`. The real executable loads the TM library by the controlDict `libs` entry (round 54). 476 steps to t = 100, 11 s. **Reference** (`refs/fc_coupled_r56.ref.txt.gz`, `scripts/extract_fullcoupling_coupled.py`): for EVERY step the neutroRegion `disp` (the displacement `deformMesh()` of that step read; all patches `zeroGradient`, so the boundary values are the owner cells'), the step's `deltaT` (17 digits, the log's `deltaT =` of the previous step; 1 for step 1), `keff_ previous`, `keff_` and `power:`; for steps 1-30, every 10th after and the last: the moved `points`, `flux0`, `flux1`, `powerDensity`, `meshPhi` (internal faces). At step 1 `disp` is uniformly zero (the mesh is "moved" onto its own points: `moving()` becomes true, `V0 = V`, `meshPhi = 0`).

## Comparison criteria (fixed here; none will change after seeing results)

1. **Inputs are upstream's.** The port is given the dumped `disp` of each step (cell values; boundary = owner cell values, `zeroGradient`), the dumped `deltaT`, `pTarget = 1e7` and the initial `keff 1.003457` of `0/uniform/reactorState`, `defaultFlux` (uniform 1, `fixedValue 0` on all patches but `frontAndBack`), the shipped `nuclearData` and `neutronicsProperties`, and the shipped `polyMesh`. Nothing else of upstream's output is an input. The port's linear solver is basic-lib's PCG at the tight tolerance (named deviation: upstream's PCG/DIC; round 4 onwards).
2. **Moved points, every kept step**: `max|port - up|` over all point coordinates `<= 1e-12 m` (mesh extent 0.1 to 1 m; bit-identity is the goal; the `volPointInterpolation` weights are the only arithmetic). First diverging step reported.
3. **`meshPhi`, internal faces, every kept step**: `max|port - up| / max|up| <= 1e-9` (goal: 0; the dt is the 17-digit log value).
4. **`keff` and `power` of every step 1-476**: relative difference `<= 1e-9` each; first step above `1e-9` and the worst reported. **Fluxes** `flux0`, `flux1` and `powerDensity` at every kept step: `max|port - up| / max|up| <= 1e-9`.
5. **Controls (each must FAIL its comparison)**: **a** deformation off (the mesh stays at its original points): points fail by construction; `keff` and `power` at step 100 differ by `> 1e-6` relative. **b** `Corrected` laplacian replaced by `Uncorrected`: `keff` at step 100 differs by `> 1e-8` relative. **c** (V0 refreshed every call) is round 30's control, not repeated. **d** `power()` taken with the volumes of the undeformed mesh: `power` of step 100 differs by `> 1e-6`.
6. **Earlier numbers do not move** (static meshes reduce to the old path bit for bit): `--lib neutronics`, `--lib multi_region`, `--lib workflow`, `genfoam_neutronics_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_msfr_transient_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_mesh_deformation_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_mesh_to_mesh_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_coupled_deformation_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_msfr_coupled_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_fullcoupling_fluid_vs_upstream` pass with their recorded numbers; anything that moves is listed old/new (1e-9 direct, 1e-4 propagated).
7. **Moving-mesh ddt of the neutronics (item 1)**: the neutronics `ddt` helper with moving volumes reproduces round 30's real-class `fvm::ddt` `diag` and `source` (3 x 93 288 values) bit for bit on the round-30 probe's meshes, AND with a static mesh equals the old `euler_ddt` bit for bit (unit test); a static-volume ddt on the moving mesh differs from the real `source` (control).
8. **`meshPhi` old time (item 5)**: the real class's `meshPhi.oldTime()` after each call of the round-30 probe equals the port's `mesh_phi_old()` bit for bit, 4 calls.
9. **Item 2**: `MultiPhysicsSolver` given region meshes and a `meshDeformation` dictionary calls `deform_region_mesh` before each model's `correct`, every Picard iteration (a counting test); a region not listed is untouched; a thermal-hydraulics region listed in `meshDeformation` is REFUSED by name (the cell-centred `onePhase` solver and the per-cell TH stand-in take no moving mesh: not ported, issue filed).

Not switched: `PolyMesh::read` (decision 3), `appbuilder::case_runner` (generic OpenFOAM solvers, `FoamCase::read`, no GeN-Foam consumer), `view_factor_radiation`, HTR-10 CSV readers, `upstream_differential` dumps, test-only `FoamFile::parse` calls on in-source text. No kovan review stamp in any touched folder (`review.md` of `basic-lib/src/io` and `field_reader` hold `kind = "note"` only).

**R6 (measured, probe not committed: it tokenised every numeric token of `cases/**`, gunzipping the 63 `.gz` files, and compared `str::parse` with `parse_foam_f64`).** 2 593 097 numeric tokens, 331 055 with 9 or more digits: **4 differ, all of them the polyMesh `points` coordinates of `msfr_neutro` already switched in round 49; 0 differ in every `0/`, `restart_165`, `constant/` and `system/` file, text or gzipped.** Prediction R6 as worded (fraction < 1e-3, zero below 8 digits): **held, but trivially**; it overturns R2's premise.

**Per test, before/after (all 84 test binaries of appbuilder-lib `--lib --tests`, 1042 passed, 0 failed, 68 ignored, both runs, `--nocapture` output compared line by line after sorting and removing timings):** every printed number is **identical before and after** (bit-identical: yes) in all 84 binaries. The only differences are non-numerical: wall-clock seconds, thread ids in a panic message, print order of parallel tests, and the key order of a printed JSON map (`F6 first stop step`). So no pin moved, none needed a re-pin, no gate was tightened (nothing became more identical) and none loosened.

| id | held? |
|---|---|
| R1 | **held** (all hand-typed-input tests unchanged) |
| R2 | **missed**: no recorded value moves at all. The committed GeN-Foam cases contain no number that the two roundings read differently except the 4 points; round 49 already absorbed them |

| R8 | **held** (611 passed, 0 failed) |

**Why nothing moves and what the change is worth.** The switch is correct and cheap but, on the cases committed here, it is inert: OpenFOAM wrote its fields with `writePrecision` 6 to 10 and short hand-typed dictionaries, and a 6 to 10 digit decimal splits the two roundings in roughly 1 of 10^4 numbers; the shipped files contain 2.6 million numbers and only the 52 860 point coordinates (written with 10 digits) hit it. The reader pin is the new tests: `tests/genfoam_number_readers_esi_gh1909.rs` (appbuilder: the four `field_reader` internal-field forms read `0.8417393185` as `0.84173931849999994`) and `tests/io_roundtrip.rs` (basic-lib: the six `FoamFile`/`read_vol_*_field` ESI entry points against their correctly rounded defaults). A case written by a run at `writePrecision 17` (the 16-digit stage dumps of the cfMesh comparison are the example of a lossy dump) WOULD move; none is committed for GeN-Foam.

Gaps, stated: the BC scalar payload site (`parse_uniform_scalar_payload`) has no dedicated assertion (needs a mesh); `one_phase_cc::parse_value`, `allrun`, `reactor_state` and `external_source_case::parse_scalar` are covered only through the whole-suite re-run, which cannot move for the reason above.

Another agent writes Round 58: keep both on merge.

## What was read before the predictions (upstream 652b3da / ESI v2506)

* **The main loop** (`GeN-Foam/GeN-Foam.C`): `runTime++`; `mapAllFields`; per solver `deformMesh()`, `correctPhysics()`, `correctBaffleLessFields()`; `adjustDeltaT` (`setDeltaT.C`: min of the solvers' `maxDeltaT()`, at most `deltaTFactor` 1.2 times `deltaT`). The shipped `multiRegionCouplingDict_steadyState` has NO `multiPhysicsSolvers`: each region is its own solver, there is no Picard loop. `multiPhysicsSolver` (what `MultiPhysicsSolver`/`RegionModel` port) is not used by this tutorial; the loop that is used is `regionSolvers` + the main loop, ported as `multi_region::region_solvers::RegionSolvers` (enum dispatch over `onePhase`, `diffusionNeutronics`, `legacyThermoMechanics`).
* **`mapAllFields`** (`meshHandler.C:219-270`, `meshHandlerTemplates.C:36-86`): target `i`, source `j`, both in `regionSolvers` order; per field pair, if the target region has a field of that name, `mappingList_[i][j].mapTgtToSrc(src, plusEqOp, tgt)`, then `correctBoundaryConditions()`. With `removeBaffles` true for the SOURCE region (the shipped `fluidRegion`), the source is `<name>.baffleLess`, a copy refreshed by `correctBaffleLessFields()` after the region's `correctPhysics()` (`thermalHydraulicsModel.C:312-380`: the primitive field copied). The shipped fluid mesh has no baffle (the real log: `Writing 0 duplicate faces`), so its baffle-less mesh is the same mesh and the copy is the field itself.
* **Mapped fields are never read from `0/`** except where `READ_IF_PRESENT` (`neutronics.C:150-215`: `TFuel`, `TClad`, `TCool`, `TStruct` default 0; `rhoCool` SMALL); the TM fields `TStructFromTH`, `TFuel` are `NO_READ` with default 1 (`thermoMechanics.C:128-155`), `powerDensityNeutronics` 0. The shipped `0/` has none of them, so the port starts from these defaults and the first `mapAllFields` fills the overlap. The `-initializeMappedFields` pass only writes them (not ported; its output is never read by the port).
* **Meshes**: fluid 144 cells (area 0.025), neutro 432, thermoMechanical 432 (area 0.05); the fluid overlaps one third of each, so 288 TM cells keep the default `TStructFromTH = TFuel = 1` for the whole run (visible in the real fields). `meshToMesh` addressing is built once on the undeformed meshes (`meshHandler.C:192-201`); only `neutroRegion` is in `meshDeformation` (field `disp`, mapped from the TM `meshDisp`, `zeroGradient` patches).
* **`maxDeltaT`**: `onePhase::maxDeltaT` (the Courant limit, round 55), `diffusionNeutronics::maxDeltaT` (`diffusionNeutronics.C:220-244`: only once `time > deltaT`, `maxPowerVariation 0.01`, `pTotOld_ = power()` at the start of `correctPhysics()`), `legacyThermoMechanics::maxDeltaT = GREAT`.
* **Searched (reuse)**: `OnePhaseCcSolver` (round 55: `set_power_density`, `set_structure_power_density`, `fuel_clad_temperatures`, `max_delta_t`), `DiffusionNeutronics::rebind_mesh` + `deform_mesh_at` (round 56), `LegacyFvmThermoMechanics::{set_coupling_fields, correct_physics, mesh_displacement}` (rounds 23-27), `RegionMeshMap`/`OverlapMesh::from_deformable` (rounds 28/30), `adjust_delta_t`, `diffusion_max_delta_t`, `CouplingDict` (new `mappings_from_dict`: the old reader required `multiPhysicsSolvers`). Nothing existed that runs the three together.

The shipped `2D_fullCoupling` `steadyState` stage with the edits of `scripts/make_fullcoupling_coupled_case.sh` (round 56: `model diffusionNeutronics`, `eigenvalueNeutronics true`, `endTime 100`, `deltaT 1`, `writePrecision 17`, `libs` for the TM library (the real run only), every `tolerance 1e-14`, `relTol 0`, `p_rgh` GAMG -> PCG/DIC, the TM `TStruct` GAMG -> PBiCG/DILU (named deviation of round 21), `multiRegionCouplingDict_steadyState`). # Round 58 (gh:#1909 B4, child of #1216; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Match all upstream"; on #1909: "(2) The two-phase OpenFOAM-order switch comes AFTER the B4 matrix-assembly work (investigate the NaN first)"): the two-phase solver's matrices in OpenFOAM's operation order, the NaN of round 49, then the helper switch

AI-written, not human-reviewed. Research, education and V&V only (`RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`). Written 2026-11-27. **Predictions and criteria below are committed BEFORE any change of the two-phase solver's defaults and before any port run of the changed code.**

## Checked first (what exists; reuse)

* Round 46 did B4 for `one_phase_fc`: `UEqnCc` (`one_phase_cc/flow.rs`: `D`, per-boundary-face `internalCoeffs`/`boundaryCoeffs` and the source kept apart; `relax`, `a`, `h`, `add` in `fvMatrix` order), `Eqn::neg_laplacian_internal` / `neg_laplacian_boundary_coeffs` / `flux_of_coeffs`, `fv::reconstruct_openfoam` (`Tensor::safeInv`), `dev2_div_openfoam` (in `two_phase/mod.rs`), `Geometry::new_openfoam`, `fv::interp_linear_openfoam`, `fv::flux_openfoam`. The two-phase solver (`two_phase/mod.rs`) still has: `VecEqn` (per-cell `cmptAv` folded into the diagonal as each boundary term is assembled, `h_corr` per component, boundary sources folded into the source), `Eqn::neg_laplacian` (boundary folded into diag and source) for the `p_rgh` and `he` equations, `Eqn::laplacian_flux` through `sn_grad` for `pEqnIncomp.flux()`, `fv::reconstruct` (Cramer), `dev2_div` with `w P + (1 - w) N`, every term of a matrix accumulated onto one running diagonal.
* Upstream read (GeN-Foam 652b3da `solvers/twoPhase/include/`): `UEqns_2p.H` (`UEqn = div + ((-laplacian) - fvc::div(dev2)) + Sp((1/3) tr Kd1s) + (dev(Kd1s) & U) == fvOptions`, then `+= virtualMass force` (`alphaRhoVm * (ddt + div + SuSp - (...))`, `fvMatrix::operator*=` scales the boundary coefficients by the owner value), then `+= SuSp(-contErr)`; `//UEqn1.relax(); //UEqn2.relax();` commented out), `pEqnf_2p.H` (`implicitPartialElimination` branch: `Af = interpolate(UEqn.A()) + alphaRhofByDt`, `phiH = flux(UEqn.H()) + phiS`), `calcComp_2p.H` (`pEqnComp = (ddt + div - Sp)/rho + (alpha psi/rho) * p_rghCorr`), `solveP_rgh_2p.H` (`pEqnIncomp = fvc::div(phiHbyA) - fvm::laplacian(rAUf, p_rgh)`, `pEqn = comp1 + comp2 + incomp`, `pEqn.setReference`, **`pEqn.relax()`**, solve), `EEqns_2p.H` (each `fvm` term its own matrix; **`E1Eqn.relax()`** before the solve). With `relaxationFactors.equations ".*" 1` (the shipped two-phase cases) `fvMatrix::relax(1)` runs on `p_rgh` and on both `h.<fluid>` equations (`fvMatrix::relax()` selects by `relaxEquation(psi.name())`, and `".*"` matches). Round 13 / 38 recorded that `relax(1)` is the identity ONLY where a matrix is diagonally dominant AND has no boundary `internalCoeffs`; `D += cmptMax(cmptMag(ic))` then `D -= cmptMin(ic)` is `(D + ic) - ic`, an ulp of `D` at a `fixedValue` patch cell, and `S += (D - D0) psi` carries it into the source. The two-phase port calls NO `relax` on its `p_rgh` or `he` matrices (checked: `grep relax` finds only the field relaxations `relax_he`, `relax_phi`, `relax_alpha`).
* Kovan review: every `review.md` under `src/genfoam/thermal_hydraulics/solver/` has 0 `kind = "review"` blocks, so no function of the two-phase solver is closed; if one turned out to be, the round stops there.

## What changes (B4 for the two-phase solver; the old forms stay as named options or as the old functions, nothing is silently removed)

1. **`VecEqn` takes `UEqnCc`'s form** (REUSE, not a second implementation): `D`, `ic[face]`, `bcoef[face]`, source per component apart; `A()` = `(D + cmptAv(ic) per face)/V`, `H()` with `boundaryDiagCmpt` and `boundaryCoeffs` added after; the assembly as upstream's expression: `div` (own matrix), `((-laplacian) - dev2 field)` (own matrix, added whole), `Sp(Kd/3)` (own matrix), `+ (dev(Kd) & U)`, the virtual-mass matrix scaled and added whole, `SuSp(-contErr)` added whole. `UEqnCc::boundary_convection/laplacian` gain `phis` for `pressureInletOutletVelocity`. No relax (upstream has none).
2. **Pressure equation**: `pEqnIncomp` as `fvMatrix` keeps `internalCoeffs`/`boundaryCoeffs` (`neg_laplacian_internal`, `neg_laplacian_boundary_coeffs`), `pEqn = comp1 + comp2 + incomp` with each field term subtracted from its own matrix, `pEqn.relax()` (`fvMatrix::relax(1)`, scalar) where the case's `equations` select `p_rgh`, `solveSegregated` folding (`addBoundaryDiag`, `addBoundarySource`), `pEqnIncomp.flux()` as `flux_of_coeffs`, `reconstruct_openfoam`.

## FINDING (read from upstream before anything was ported): the shipped `Allrun` transient is a DIFFUSION transient, not point kinetics

`Tutorials/featureCases/2D_fullCoupling/Allrun` `setTransientNoDriveline` sets `model pointKinetics` and `eigenvalueNeutronics false` in `neutronicsProperties`, `startTime 100`, `endTime 200`, `deltaT 1e-6`, `absoluteDrivelineExpansionCoeff 0`, and copies `multiRegionCouplingDict_transient`. But the SOLVER of `neutroRegion` is chosen by `system/controlDict` `regionSolvers { neutroRegion diffusionNeutronics; }`, which the Allrun does not edit; the `neutronicsProperties` `model` key is read only by `modifyDictLegacy.H`, included only under `GeN-Foam -legacy` (`GeN-Foam.C:130-137`), which the Allrun does not pass. Measured (real binary, `scripts/make_fullcoupling_transient_case.sh`, `SHIPPED=1`): the log shows `Accelerating neutronic solution: integral predictor`, `fluxStar0` and `DICPCG` solves, `power:` lines: **upstream's shipped transient runs the diffusion model in time-dependent mode** (precursor transport, `integralPredictor`), and the tutorial README ("a transient based on point-kinetics") is stale against the code. The point-kinetics stage the task names exists only with one further edit, `regionSolvers.neutroRegion pointKinetics` (variant **PK**, `scripts/make_fullcoupling_transient_case.sh` without `SHIPPED`).

Consequences, stated plainly: (1) the as-shipped stage (variant **SH**) needs the transient diffusion model with `integralPredictor` (gh:#1919, not ported): it is REFUSED by name by the port's reader today (`eigenvalueNeutronics false`), and this round does not change that; (2) the PK variant is the documented variant this round ports. Filed for the maintainer: report to the upstream authors (draft #1910) that the Allrun's transient does not select point kinetics.

The transient therefore starts from that time (`startTime` edit), not 100.

Real run: the shipped `Allrun` stages plus the one `regionSolvers.neutroRegion pointKinetics` edit, from the steady state of `ADJ=1` (t = 100, 476 steps), `scripts/make_fullcoupling_transient_case.sh` without `SHIPPED`, `scripts/run_fullcoupling_transient.sh`; a per-step extractor like round 60's (`scripts/extract_fullcoupling_transient.py` extended for the PK log: `power`, `fission`, `totalReactivity`, `extReactivity`, TFuel term, precursor powers, fingerprints of every written field, full fields at steps 1-10, every 25th and the last). Port: `RegionSolvers::restart_transient` with `neutroRegion pointKinetics` (the refusal lifted), `PointKineticNeutronics` built from the READ fluxes and precursors, `RegionSolver::PointKinetics` in the three-region loop; reuse of round 36/48 point kinetics, round 60 restart emulation. Criteria are those of round 59 (1-6) applied at round 60's protocol:

1. runs without refusal, step count equal to the real run, `dt` sequence <= 1e-9 relative, final time <= 1e-12 relative;
2. `power`, fission power, `totalReactivity`, `extReactivity`, TFuel term, precursor powers <= 1e-9 relative (terms below 1e-12 of `totalReactivity` absolute 1e-15);

6. earlier numbers do not move.

### Not done (and why)

* Point kinetics: feedback zones (`*FeedbackZones`), external source, decay power, GEM and liquid fuel are refused by name by the reader (none is in this case); `read` of a case that STARTS as point kinetics (a restart from files on disk is still emulated in memory).
* The first `p_rgh` solve of the OWN-state restart stays at 3.1e-10: it is the steady state's `U` round-off (9.8e-14), a property of the 476-step steady state, not of the restart. Making it vanish needs a bit-identical steady-state `U` (the round 60 steady state agrees to 9.8e-14, inside its 1e-9 gate).

## Allrun findings (the real binary, as shipped, serial; scratch `/home/user/upstream-build/fftf`, deleted after extraction)

1. `foamDictionary`, which the Allrun calls, was not built in this ESI build: built with `wmake` from the shipped source (`applications/utilities/miscellaneous/foamDictionary`, 4 s). Its edits then run exactly as shipped.
2. `libfieldFunctionObjects.so` (the `massFlow`/`TBulk` function objects of `controlDict`) is not built here: one `Could not load` warning per function object, the solve is unaffected, no `postProcessing` output. Not an Allrun defect.

4. `removeBaffles` does NOT touch the solved mesh: `thermalHydraulicsModel::correctBaffleLessFields` and `meshHandler` use the baffle-less copy (`0/fluidRegion.baffleLess`, 1 216 duplicate faces) only as the SOURCE of `meshToMesh` maps to other regions. ## Comparison criteria (fixed here; none will change after seeing results)

Variants of `cases/fullcoupling_fluid` made by `scripts/make_fftf_piece_variants.py` (one edit each; real binary: `scripts/run_fftf_piece_variants.sh`; every solver 1e-14, `writePrecision 17`, 20 steps: the round 55 harness, `tests/genfoam_fftf_pieces_vs_upstream.rs`):

1. **Each variant is read and run by the port without refusal**, 20 steps; step count equals the reference's.
2. **Fields** `U` (gated on `max|U|`; components reported), `p`, `p_rgh`, `T`, `alphaPhi`, `htc`, `T.passiveStructure`, `T.fuelAvForNeutronics` at every kept step: `max|port - up| / max|up| <= 1e-9`.
3. **Time-step sequence** `<= 1e-12` relative; **solve logs**: `p_rgh`/`h` initial residuals of solves whose upstream residual exceeds `1e-10` within `1e-6` relative, iterations within 1 (noise-floor counts reported, not gated).

## Criteria (fixed here; none will change after seeing results)

1. `w7_tort` is read and run by the port without refusal, 20 steps, step count equal to the reference.
2. Fields `U` (gated on `max|U|`), `p`, `p_rgh`, `T`, `alphaPhi`, `htc`, `T.passiveStructure`, `T.fuelAvForNeutronics` at every kept step `<= 1e-9` relative to the max of the reference; `dt` sequence `<= 1e-12`; `T` lines `<= 1e-9`; solve logs: initial residual absolute difference `<= 1e-11` and iteration difference `<= 5` for solves whose upstream residual exceeds 1e-10 (the standing pins of rounds 55/62); noise-floor iteration counts REPORTED, NOT gated.
3. Controls (each must differ from the `w7_tort` reference): the port with the UEqn tortuosity off (EEqn on) differs in `U` or `T` by more than 1e-9; the port with the EEqn tortuosity off (UEqn on) differs by more than 1e-9 in `T`.
4. The tensor-gamma Laplacian is unit-tested on its own: for a diagonal `gamma = g I` it reproduces the scalar-gamma matrix coefficients to <= 1e-12 relative, and `SfGammaSn`/`SfGammaCorr` of a hand-built non-axis-aligned face equal `SfGamma = Sf & gamma`, `SfGammaSn = SfGamma & Sn`, `SfGammaCorr = SfGamma - SfGammaSn Sn` to 1e-14.
5. Earlier numbers (rounds 3-63) do not move: `genfoam_fftf_pieces_vs_upstream` (w1-w6), `genfoam_fullcoupling_fluid_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_fullcoupling_three_region_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_fullcoupling_transient_vs_upstream` pass at their pins; anything that moves is listed old/new (1e-9 direct, 1e-4 propagated).
6. `genfoam_coupled_tutorials_requirements` re-pinned to the first refusal of the shipped FFTF case still missing; the round 54 table row and gap-audit row struck through.
7. Wedge patches: the tortuous path applies to EVERY face of the fluid mesh (identity tortuosity outside the zone), including the 14 328 wedge faces of the FFTF vessel; the wedge boundary value of the tensor is `cellT & I & cellT.T()`. Whatever of this the port does not carry is REFUSED by name; it is not differenced (no wedge case among the variants).

# Round 65 (gh:#1929, #1928 under #1870/#1216; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Port genfoam exhaustively", "Match all upstream", "U go couple lah"): `porousKEpsilon` with `zeroGradient`/`calculated` patches, `mappedWall`, and the shipped 2D_FFTF steady state in the port against the round 62 tight reference

AI-written, not human-reviewed. Research, education and V&V only (`RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`). Written 2026-11-27. Another agent writes Round 63 (#1927): keep both on merge. **Predictions and every criterion below are committed BEFORE the first port run of the `w8`-`w10` variants and BEFORE the first port run of the shipped FFTF case.** The real-binary references of the variants were extracted first (inputs of the test, not of the port): `refs/fftf_r65_w{8_zg,9_calc,10_mapped}*` (refs submodule `5159c85`).

## Read first (upstream 652b3da / ESI v2506, before any port line)

* `porousKEpsilon.C` has NO wall-function code: `correctNut()` is `nut = Cmu k^2/epsilon; nut.correctBoundaryConditions(); alphat = rho nut/Prt; alphat.correctBoundaryConditions(); nut += pos(structure) magU DhStruct/laminarReStruct; nut.correctBoundaryConditions()`. Which patches carry wall functions is decided ONLY by the patch types in `0/fluidRegion/{k,epsilon,nut}`. The shipped FFTF files carry none: `k`, `epsilon` `zeroGradient` on every patch (`wedge` on the two wedge patches); `nut` `zeroGradient` on `vesselWall`, `outVesselFrontAndBack`, `outVesselWall`, `secLoopFrontAndBack`, `hotLegSecondaryOutlet`, `coldLegSecondaryInlet`, `secLoopWall`, `vesselValve` and `calculated value uniform 0` on `baffle1_master/slave`, `baffle2_master/slave`, `baffle3`, `baffle4`; `alphat` `zeroGradient` on the vessel/outer/secLoop walls and `vesselValve`, `calculated` on the baffles and on `hotLegSecondaryOutlet`/`coldLegSecondaryInlet`. The `epsilon` equation therefore runs with no `updateCoeffs` effect and no `boundaryManipulate`.
* A `calculated` patch of an expression assignment takes the EXPRESSION's patch values (`nut_ = Cmu*sqr(k_)/epsilon_` assigns `Cmu k_b^2/eps_b`; `nut_ += pos(structure_) magU DhStruct/laminarReStruct` adds the patch values of `magU` = `mag(U_b)` as `fluid_.magU() = mag(U)` (`pEqn_1p.H:84`) left them after `U.correctBoundaryConditions()`), while a `zeroGradient` patch re-evaluates to the owner value. `alphaEff` of `EEqn_1p.H` is `thermo.alphaEff(alphat)` = `alpha_ + alphat` on the patches too.
* `mappedWall`: the only users of `mappedPatchBase` in GeN-Foam are the `NusseltThermalBaffle1D` BC (`grep -rn mappedPatch src/` finds nothing else); the FFTF baffles carry `slip`/`zeroGradient`/`fixedFluxPressure`/`calculated`, so in the fluid region a `mappedWall` is a plain wall `fvPatch` and its `sampleRegion fluid` is never resolved (the real binary ran it in round 62). `removeBaffles` acts only on the `meshToMesh` source copy (round 62 finding 4).
* The port's reader accepted only wall-function `nut`/`k`/`epsilon` on `wall` patches and `zeroGradient`/`wedge` `alphat`, and the energy equation took `alphat` on patches as 0.

## Variants (real binary, 20 steps, tight protocol; `scripts/make_fftf_turb_variants.py`, `run_fftf_turb_variants.sh`, `extract_patch_values.py`)

Base `cases/fullcoupling_fluid` switched to `RAS porousKEpsilon` with the FFTF coefficients (`DhStruct 1`; `k 1`, `epsilon 200`; relaxation 0.6 on `k.*`/`epsilon.*`) then ONLY the patch types differ: `w8_zg` (every `k`/`epsilon`/`nut`/`alphat` patch `zeroGradient`, `fixedWalls` `noSlip`), `w9_calc` (`nut`, `alphat` `calculated` on `fixedWalls`, `alphat` `calculated` on `inlet`/`outlet`, `fixedWalls` `slip`), `w10_mapped` (`fixedWalls` split into two `mappedWall` patches `baffle3`/`baffle4` with the FFTF dictionary, `calculated` `nut`/`alphat`).

## Criteria (fixed here; none will change after seeing results)

1. Each variant is read and run by the port without refusal, 20 steps, step count equal to the reference's.
2. Fields `U` (gated on `max|U|`), `p`, `p_rgh`, `T`, `alphaPhi`, `htc`, `T.passiveStructure`, `T.fuelAvForNeutronics`, and now `k`, `epsilon`, `nut`, `alphat` (cells) at every kept step `<= 1e-9` of the field's max; `nut` and `alphat` PATCH values (`P` lines) `<= 1e-9` of the field's max; `dt` `<= 1e-12`; `T` lines `<= 1e-9`; solve logs: initial residual absolute difference `<= 1e-11`, iteration difference `<= 5` for solves above `1e-10` (standing pins); noise-floor iteration counts REPORTED, NOT GATED.

Controls (each must differ): the port with `alphat` patch values forced to 0 in the energy equation (the old behaviour) differs from `w9_calc` by more than `1e-9` in `T`; the port on `w9_calc` with `calculated` patches forced to the owner value (what `zeroGradient` would give) differs in `U` or `T` by more than `1e-9`.
4. Earlier numbers (rounds 3-64) do not move: `genfoam_fftf_pieces_vs_upstream` w1-w7, `genfoam_msfr_th_*`, `genfoam_fullcoupling_*`, `genfoam_coupled_tutorials_requirements`, `--lib one_phase`; anything that moves (the energy-equation `alphat` patch value is the candidate) is listed old/new (1e-9 direct, 1e-4 propagated).

# Round 67 (gh:#1934 under #1928/#1870/#1216; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Match all upstream" = follow upstream exactly INCLUDING ITS SOLVERS and stopping rules, so the decision on #1934 is made: PORT GAMG line by line): `GAMGSolver` with `faceAreaPair` agglomeration and the `DIC` smoother, against the real binary on the shipped 2D_FFTF `p_rgh` matrix

AI-written, not human-reviewed. Research, education and V&V only (`RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`). Written 2026-11-27. **Everything under "What FFTF selects", "Criteria" and "Predictions" is committed BEFORE the first run of the ported solver on any dumped matrix or on the FFTF case** (the module `genfoam/common/gamg.rs` had only its three synthetic-grid unit tests run: they exercise no upstream number).

## What 2D_FFTF selects (read from `rootCase/system/fluidRegion/fvSolution`; ESI v2506 defaults for everything not listed)

* `p_rgh`: `solver GAMG; smoother DIC; tolerance 1e-07; relTol 0.001;` and `p_rghFinal`: the same with `relTol 0`. NOTHING else: so `agglomerator faceAreaPair` (default), `mergeLevels 1`, `nCellsInCoarsestLevel 10`, `cacheAgglomeration true`, `nPreSweeps 0`, `nPostSweeps 2`, `maxPostSweeps 4`, `postSweepsLevelMultiplier 1`, `nFinestSweeps 2`, `scaleCorrection = matrix.symmetric()` (true), `interpolateCorrection false`, `directSolveCoarsest false` (so the coarsest level is solved by `PCG`/`DIC` at the OUTER `tolerance`/`relTol`, `maxIter 1000`), `maxIter 1000`, `minIter 0`. The PIMPLE `residualControl` and `correctUntilConvergence` are already ported (round 65).
* Every shipped tutorial that selects `GAMG` for `p_rgh` (38 fluid-region `fvSolution` files, `grep -rh -A12 'solver *GAMG'` over `Tutorials/`) writes exactly `solver GAMG; smoother DIC; tolerance T; relTol R;` (T 1e-6..1e-8, R 0, plus `maxIter 25` in `2D_cavityBoussinesq`, R 0.001 in FFTF): the DIC/`faceAreaPair` defaults above are the ONLY GAMG the shipped fluid regions use. The `thermoMechanicalRegion` and `neutroRegion` `GAMG` entries (`smoother GaussSeidel`/`DICGaussSeidel`, `nCellsInCoarsestLevel 20/50`, `mergeLevels 1`, `cacheAgglomeration true`, `agglomerator faceAreaPair`, `processorAgglomerator masterCoarsest`) are NOT ported by this round and stay refused/substituted as before.
* Upstream details read (not assumed): `faceAreaPairGAMGAgglomeration.C:55-76`: with the default `updateInterval 1` `requiresUpdate()` is always true, so the weights are `mag(cmptMultiply(Sf/sqrt(magSf), (1, 1.01, 1.02)))`, NOT `magSf`; `pairGAMGAgglomerate.C`: `pairGAMGAgglomeration::forward_` is a `static bool` toggled on EVERY `agglomerate` call (the rejected last level included) and `true` at process start; the agglomeration is cached in the mesh registry under the name `GAMGAgglomeration`, so `p_rgh` and `p_rghFinal` SHARE the first one built; `GAMGSolver` is rebuilt (coarse matrices re-agglomerated, DIC reciprocal diagonals recomputed) at every solve; `DICSmoother::smooth` uses `lduMatrix::residual` (`source - diag psi`, then the faces subtracted: NOT `source - Amul`); `GAMGSolver::scale` divides by `stabilise(sf1, vsmall)`.
* Refused by name (not ported, not verified): processor agglomeration and every parallel path, coupled interfaces, asymmetric matrices (`lower != upper` bitwise), `nPreSweeps != 0`, `interpolateCorrection true`, `directSolveCoarsest true`, `mergeLevels != 1`, `cacheAgglomeration false`, agglomerators other than `faceAreaPair` (so `algebraicPair` is refused), smoothers other than `DIC`.

## Method

1. A COPY of the five `GAMGSolver*.C` files and the header, renamed `GAMGdump` (`upstream_driver/gamg_dump/`; the shipped tree is untouched), builds `libGAMGdump.so`; `scripts/run_fftf_gamg_real.sh` runs the REAL `GeN-Foam` with `solver GAMGdump` for `p_rgh`/`p_rghFinal` and `libs` loading it. It writes, for the first `p_rgh` solve of step 1: the fine matrix (`lowerAddr`, `upperAddr`, `diag`, `upper`, `source`, `psi0`), the whole agglomeration (`restrictAddressing`, `faceRestrictAddressing`, `faceFlipMap`, coarse addressing, coarse `diag`/`upper` of every level), the final `psi`; and for every solve one residual per V-cycle. The matrix of this dump is UPSTREAM's own (taken inside the real run), so the single-solve comparison (b) feeds both codes the same bits.
2. The port builds the agglomeration from the mesh of the shipped case alone (`face_area_pair_weights` of `Sf` of the internal faces, `pair_agglomerate`), then solves the dumped system with `gamg_dic_solve`.

## Criteria (fixed here; none will change after seeing results)

* **(a) Agglomeration, bit-identical.** From the FFTF fluid mesh only: number of levels, and for every level `nCells`, `nFaces`, `restrictAddressing`, `faceRestrictAddressing`, `faceFlipMap`, the coarse `lowerAddr`/`upperAddr`: equal to the dump with ZERO differences. Coarse matrix `diag` and `upper` of every level (from the dumped fine matrix): equal bit for bit.
* **(b) Single solve.** The dumped system (tolerance `1e-14`, `relTol 0`, `maxIter 1000`, as the tight real run): the port's residual after EVERY V-cycle equals the dump's bit for bit, the iteration count equals, and the final `psi` equals bit for bit. A 1e-9 relative allowance on a cycle's residual applies only with an explained round-off cause; the first differing cycle and its size are reported.
* **(c) FFTF steady state, GAMG as shipped, tight tolerances** (every `tolerance 1e-14`, `relTol 0`, `writePrecision 17`; `p_rgh` KEEPS `solver GAMG; smoother DIC;`; real reference `refs/gamg_r67_tight_*`, at least 20 steps, kept steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 20 and the last, under 10 MB): `dt` sequence `<= 1e-12` relative; `T` lines `<= 1e-9`; every `p_rgh` solve's initial residual (absolute `<= 1e-11` for solves above `1e-10`); `p_rgh` GAMG iteration counts: equal for every solve that stops below `maxIter` (a solve that reaches `maxIter 1000` at the V-cycle round-off floor is REPORTED, NOT GATED, as the maintainer standard for noise-floor counts); fields `U` (on `max|U|`), `p`, `p_rgh`, `T`, `k`, `epsilon`, `nut`, `alphaPhi`, `htc`, `T.passiveStructure`, `T.fuelAvForNeutronics` at the kept steps `<= 1e-9`. First diverging step and cause recorded.
* **(d) FFTF steady state as shipped (loose tolerances, GAMG)**: the real as-shipped log of round 62 (`refs/fftf_r62_asshipped_ss_first1804_log.ref.txt.gz`, 1 804 steps, printed to 7 significant digits): the port runs as many steps as is practical (target 300; the run is stopped at 90 minutes of wall time and the number reached recorded); gates: every `p_rgh` GAMG iteration count EQUAL; initial residuals `<= 1e-6` relative for solves above `1e-10`; `h`, `k`, `epsilon` iteration counts within 1; `dt` sequence and `T` lines `<= 1e-6` relative (log precision). First diverging step and cause recorded. There are no fields in this reference (nothing is written before t = 900).
* **Controls (each must differ from the dump)**: the agglomeration from weights `|upper|` of the fine matrix (basic-lib's old algebraic pairing, `algebraicPair` in spirit) instead of `faceAreaPair`; the same with `magSf` weights (the `updateInterval 0` branch); `forward_` started `false`; the solve with `nFinestSweeps 1` (wrong smoothing); with `scaleCorrection false`. Each must change the V-cycle residual sequence (or the agglomeration) by more than `1e-9` relative at some cycle.
* **Earlier numbers do not move** (`genfoam_fftf_pieces_vs_upstream`, `genfoam_fullcoupling_*`, `genfoam_msfr_*`, `genfoam_coupled_tutorials_requirements`, `--lib one_phase`, and every test of `outram-foam-basic-lib` that uses `solve_gamg_with_guess`/`gamg`, `pimple_foam`, `melt_foam`, `solid_displacement_foam`): `outram-foam-basic-lib/src/ldu_matrix/solvers/gamg.rs` is NOT edited; the new solver is a new entry point; anything that moves is listed old/new (1e-9 direct, 1e-4 propagated).

This is added to the draft upstream report (gh:#1910). To run it, `setTransient` gets one added line, `cp rootCase/0/uniform/reactorState $1/$endTimeSS/uniform/reactorState`; nothing else is changed. ~~The transient (endTime 1200) was started detached in `/home/user/upstream-build/fftf_ss900/transient`; its references are to be extracted when it ends.~~ **UPDATED 2026-11-27:** the transient cannot be run to its end here: it is Courant-limited (`maxCo 1`) at deltaT about 2.0e-3 s, so the 300 s are about 150 000 steps (measured 70 steps/min, about 36 h), and `writeControl timeStep; writeInterval 50` writes about 12 MB every 50 steps (about 36 GB in all). It was stopped by hand after **1334 steps (t = 902.63)**. # Round 71 (gh:#1911, 3D_SmallESFR; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Port genfoam exhaustively", "Match all upstream", and on #1903 "3D MSFR or ESFR"): what the shipped ESFR fluid region selects, what the port has of it, and the pieces taken in this round

The audit part reads upstream files (`Tutorials/reactorCases/3D_SmallESFR_NewSolverVerification/legacySolver`, `Allrun_parallel`, `Alltest`) and the real binary only; its one port observation is the first refusal of `OnePhaseFcCase::read`, a read, not a run.

## What the shipped tutorial is (read 2026-11-27)

`3D_SmallESFR_NewSolverVerification` runs `legacySolver` then `newSolver` (`Allrun_parallel`: `decomposePar -allRegions`, `mpirun -np 4 GeN-Foam -parallel`; steady state to `endTime 200`, `deltaT 1`, `adjustTimeStep false`; `Alltest` gates `keff` 0.936827 +- 0.1 %). Three regions: `fluidRegion onePhase` (23 322 cells, zones `axialReflector 6540, controlRod 432, radialReflector 5040, innerCore 3300, follower 1728, outerCore 3240, diagrid 3042`), `neutroRegion diffusionNeutronics` (23 322), `thermoMechanicalRegion legacyThermoMechanics` (23 340); `newSolver` selects `extendedThermoMechanics` (not buildable here: gap audit). `3D_SmallESFR_old` is the same with `-legacy`.

**The fluid region is `momentumMode faceCentered`** (`system/fluidRegion/fvSolution` PIMPLE: `nCorrectors 2`, `nOuterCorrectors 6`, `solveEnergy`, `solveFluidMechanics`), NOT cell-centred. The text of gh:#1911 and the round 52 work say `one_phase_cc`; the shipped case is the face-centred solver (`one_phase_fc`, `pEqnf_1p.H`), which lacks the thermo/structure machinery the cc solver gained in rounds 37, 46 and 55. Selections, each against the port:

**Real binary facts measured today** (`scripts/make_esfr_fluid_case.sh`, fluid-only): the real `GeN-Foam` runs the fluid region in **1.2 s per step** serial with the shipped `GAMG` (18 iterations for the first `p_rgh`; `smoothSolver` `h` 5-7 iterations); its log prints `T.nuclearFuelPin.*` (innerCore) and `T.nuclearFuelPinTest.*` (outerCore), so both models run; with prescribed `powerDensity` (innerCore 1e8, outerCore 8e7 W/m3: inputs, not fits) the pin fuel average rises 29 K and 23 K in the first iteration. The shipped `0/fluidRegion/powerDensityNeutronics` is `uniform 0` and outranks the dictionary value; the staged case deletes it (fluid-only reduction).
