# Round 80 (gh:#1905, child of #1216; maintainer 2026-11-28: "1905 pick it up"): the shipped `1D_MSR_pointKinetics` / `1D_thermalMSR_pointKinetics` COUPLED, step 1: cyclic (`lduInterface`) coupled interfaces in the `onePhase` fluid path

> Research, education and V&V only. AI draft, unreviewed. Predictions and criteria below were written and committed BEFORE any port run against a real-binary number of this round.

## Read before any port code (2026-11-28, GeN-Foam 652b3da on ESI v2506)

* The case (`cases/msr1d_root` = the shipped `rootCase` verbatim): one 1-D column of 640 hexahedra, `top`/`bottom` CYCLIC (`transformType translational`, separation 12 m), `walls` (1280 faces, two sides of every cell), `defaultFaces` empty. Fluid region `onePhase`, `momentumMode faceCentered`, `RAS porousKEpsilon` (`hx` zone), `heRhoThermo`/`Boussinesq` (`beta 0`, so `rho = rho0` everywhere)/`hConst`/`const`, `g = 0`, `U` `slip` on the walls, `p_rgh` `fixedFluxPressure` (closed volume: `pRefCell 0`, `pRefValue 1e5`), `T` `zeroGradient`, wall functions `kqR`/`epsilon`/`nutk`. Structures: `hx` (`volumeFraction 0.6`, `fixedTemperature 900`, `constant` htc 1.85e4, `ReynoldsPower` drag), `pump` (`momentumSource (0 0 7858.6)`, `momentumSourceTimeProfile table`, `startTime 100`), `core` with `fluidProperties.initialPowerDensity` 3.3e8 (`fluid.C:386-420`: written into `powerDensityNeutronicsToLiquid` when that file is absent; `EEqn_1p.H`: `EEqn -= alpha*powerDensity`). Solvers: `p_rgh` `GAMG`/`DIC`; every other field through the catch-all `".*"` (`PBiCGStab`/`diagonal`, `relTol 0.001`): the real log reads `diagonalPBiCGStab: Solving for h` although an `"h.*"` `smoothSolver` entry exists (OpenFOAM takes the LAST matching pattern). `relaxationFactors.equations ".*" 1`.
* The real `steadyState` stage (Allrun's edits) runs 8340 time steps to `t = 100` (`maxCo 1`, `maxDeltaT 1`, final `deltaT` 9.0e-3) in 24 s.
* OpenFOAM keeps a cyclic patch as an `lduInterface` (round 48): `fvMatrix` carries `internalCoeffs`/`boundaryCoeffs` per patch; `solveSegregated` adds `internalCoeffs` to the diagonal (`addBoundaryDiag`) and, for a SCALAR matrix, adds `boundaryCoeffs` to the source only for the NON-coupled patches (`addBoundarySource(source, false)`, `fvScalarMatrix.C`); the coupled `boundaryCoeffs` are the `interfaceBouCoeffs`: `Amul` subtracts `bou psi_nbr` after the face loop, `residual` adds it, `sumA` subtracts `bou`; `DIC`/`diagonal` preconditioners do not see them; `DICSmoother` uses `residual` with them. `fvMatrix::relax` (`fvMatrix.C:1101-1238`): for a coupled patch `D += component(ic, 0)` and `sumOff += mag(component(bc, 0))`, then `D -= component(ic, 0)` (a non-coupled patch: `cmptMax(cmptMag(ic))` in, `cmptMin(ic)` out). `fvMatrix::H()` adds `cmptMultiply(bc, patchNeighbourField)` for a coupled patch (`addBoundarySource(Hphi)`, couples true). `fvMatrix::flux()`: `ic psi_P - bc psi_N` on a coupled patch. `gaussConvectionScheme::fvmDiv`: `ic = phi w`, `bc = -phi (1 - w)` with the scheme's weights (`upwind`: `pos0(phi)`); `gaussLaplacianScheme` (uncorrected): `ic = -pGamma (-deltaCoeffs)`, `bc = pGamma deltaCoeffs` after the `-` of `-laplacian`. `surfaceInterpolationScheme::interpolate`/`dotInterpolate` on a coupled patch: `w P + (1 - w) N` from the CELL values (not `lambda (P - N) + N`, not the stored patch values); `coupledFvPatchField::snGrad = deltaCoeffs (N - P)`; `coupledFvPatchField::evaluate`: `P w + N (1 - w)`. `cyclicFvPatch::makeWeights` (`w = dni/(di + dni)`, `di = nf & (Cf - Cn)`) and `cyclicFvPatch::delta` (`ddi - dni`, parallel) give `weights` and `nonOrthDeltaCoeffs` (round 48, G2: bit-identical on this very mesh).
* GAMG (`GAMGAgglomerateLduAddressing.C`, `cyclicGAMGInterface.C`, `GAMGInterface::agglomerateCoeffs`, `GAMGSolverAgglomerateMatrix.C`, `GAMGSolverSolve.C`): the pair agglomeration uses the internal faces only (`faceAreaPair` weights), so the cells on the two sides of the seam are never merged; each coarse level gets a `cyclicGAMGInterface` whose coarse faces are the distinct `(local coarse cell, neighbour coarse cell)` pairs (swapped on the non-owner side), in first-appearance order; the coarse `interfaceBouCoeffs` are the SUMS of the fine ones over `faceRestrictAddressing`; every level's `Amul`/`residual` (smoother, `scale`, the residual of `nPreSweeps`, the coarsest `PCG`/`DIC`) carries its level's interfaces. The port's `common/gamg.rs` had none of this (it refused coupled interfaces in its module doc).
* Searched the port before writing: `cyclic_transport.rs` (round 48) is the scalar precursor equation on its own `TransportMesh`; `fv.rs` (the `onePhase` finite-volume layer) treated every boundary face as a plain patch; basic-lib's `FvMesh::cyclic_couplings` turns a seam into an LDU face (the form round 48 control S2 showed to differ: 5e-5). The mesh reader does not resolve `neighbourPatch` (`parse_cyclic_neighbours` of round 48 does). REUSED: the `cyclicFvPatch` geometry formulas of `cyclic_transport.rs` (same operation order), `parse_cyclic_neighbours`.

## Protocol

`scripts/run_msr1d_fluid_r80.sh <dir> <tight|loose> <gamg|pcg> <full|first>` on the shipped case: Allrun's `steadyState` edits, `writePrecision 17` (the log then prints residuals at 17 digits), `writeControl timeStep`; `full` writes every 100th step to `t = 100`, `first` every step of the first 60. `tight` = every tolerance 1e-14, `relTol 0`; `pcg` = `p_rgh` `GAMG` -> `PCG`/`DIC` (`GamgPolicy::SubstitutePcgDic`, the named substitute); `gamg` = as shipped (the port's `GamgPolicy::Native`, its default). The port reads the same case (`cases/msr1d_root` + the same edits), runs its own loop with its own `adjustTimeStep`; nothing of upstream's output is an input.

## Criteria (fixed now)

* **K1 fields**: `U` (gated on `max|U|`), `p`, `p_rgh`, `T`, `k`, `epsilon`, `nut`, `alphat` at every written step of `first` (60) and of `full` (every 100th): `max|port - up| / max|up| <= 1e-9` for `tight`; the `loose` runs are REPORTED, gated only at 1e-6 on the step-60 and `t = 100` states (a `relTol 0.001` solver is round-off-sensitive in its iteration count).
* **K2 time steps**: the `deltaT` sequence to `1e-12` relative (it is `maxCo`-limited, so it follows `max|phi|`).
* **K3 solves**: every `p_rgh`, `k`, `h` solve with upstream initial residual above `1e-10`: initial residual to `1e-6` relative, iteration count within 1 (noise-floor solves and solves that hit `maxIter` reported, not gated).
* **K4 `T (avg min max)`** lines to `1e-9`.
* Bit-identity is the goal; any difference above zero is reported with its size and cause (1e-9 direct, 1e-4 propagated allowance, cause explained).

Refused by name on a mesh with a cyclic patch (not reached by the shipped case): `localTortuosity`, `lumpedNuclearStructure` with `kappaMatrix`, `heatExchangers`, `passiveProperties`, `h` with `PBiCG`/`DILU` or the round-46 smoother, `k`/`epsilon` with `PBiCG`/`DILU`; MULES (round 34) and `deformMesh` (round 26) keep their refusals.

### Three earlier forms that were not upstream's (found by this comparison; each kept as a named ablation)

1. **`k`/`epsilon` assembly order** (`porousKEpsilon.C:607-647`): the port accumulated `ddt`, `div`, `laplacian`, `Su`, `SuSp`, `Sp` onto ONE running diagonal; `fvMatrix` builds each term as its own matrix and adds it whole (`(ddt + div) - laplacian == S1 - SuSp - Sp + 0 - Sp + S2`), so the per-cell sum of the face coefficients rounds before it meets the `ddt` diagonal. Before the fix `k` differed in 461 of 640 cells by 1 ulp at step 1. Default now `porous_k_epsilon_matrix`; ablation `with_folded_k_epsilon_assembly` (first difference at step 1, `U` 1.4e-11).
2. **Wall distance** (`nearWallDist` -> `face::nearestPointClassify`): the fan centre is `face::centre` (`face.C:513-573`), not the mesh face centre; `y` differed by 1 ulp in 3 cells (`epsilon` 3/640 cells at step 1). Default now `face_centre_openfoam`; earlier form `near_wall_dist_with_mesh_face_centres`.
3. **`EEqn_1p.H` assembly order**: the same as 1 for `fvm::div` and `fvm::laplacian` of `he` (T 1 ulp in 123 cells at step 1). Ablation `with_folded_energy_assembly` (first difference step 1, `T` 2.5e-16).
4. **`faceCentered` `dev2` divergence**: `fvc::div` and `fvc::grad` interpolate with `dotInterpolate`'s `lambda (P - N) + N`; the `faceCentered` branch used the weighted `w P + (1 - w) N` (rounds 73-79), which made step 3 differ (31 `p_rgh` cells by 1 ulp). Default now `dev2_div_openfoam`; control `with_weighted_dev2_interpolation` (first difference step 3, `U` 1.5e-13).

The cell-centred branch (`flow.rs`) still uses the weighted `dev2` form and its recorded numbers were not re-measured with the `dotInterpolate` form: filed (see "Not done").

**Cause of the remaining difference (explained):** the first non-identical number of every tight run is the `epsilon` wall function `Cmu^0.75 k^1.5/(kappa y)` in ONE cell, 1 ulp: PETIR's `r_powf` (the ARM optimized-routines `pow`, the crate's deterministic route) against the platform `pow` the binary calls. `first_epsilon_difference_is_the_pow_of_the_wall_function` recomputes it: at step 6, cell 579, the upstream value equals the platform-`pow` value and the port's the PETIR value, bit for bit. Everything after is that ulp propagated through a closed, nearly singular pressure system (the 1e-4 propagated allowance applies; the measured worst of the tight runs is 2.9e-12). The `loose` runs amplify it through `relTol 0.001` stopping iterates (an early `T` transient of 8.6e-6 that decays to 1.3e-9 by `t = 100`), reported, not gated except at the final state.

## Read before any port code (2026-11-28, GeN-Foam 652b3da on ESI v2506)

* **The shipped `1D_thermalMSR_pointKinetics` has NO `kappaMatrix` key.** Its `core` `lumpedNuclearStructure` (`nodesNumber 1`, `heatConductances (450000 225000)`, `rhoCp (5357692)`, `powerDensity 5e6`, `volumetricArea 40`, `T0 900`) takes `kappaMatrix = 0` (`lumpedNuclearStructure.C:208`, `lookupOrDefault`). Upstream still evaluates `laplacianTmatrix_ = fvc::laplacian(Tmatrix_)` in every `correct` (`:445`), on a `Tmatrix_` that stays 0 (`:431-434` sets it only where `kappaMatrix != 0`), and never uses it (`:338`, `:356`, `:375`, `:398`: every use is under `kappaMatrix != 0`). The round-80 refusal (`one_phase_cc.rs`: `radial.needs_laplacian` on a cyclic mesh) is keyed on `kappaMatrix != 0`, so it was **never reached by the shipped case**: a probe of the reader (`thermal_msr_case_reads`, no comparison) reads the case as is. ~~gh:#1962: "This case adds a `lumpedNuclearStructure` power model with a `kappaMatrix`" and "Since round 80, the port refuses `lumpedNuclearStructure` with `kappaMatrix` by name"~~ **CORRECTED 2026-11-28 (round 81, read from the shipped `phaseProperties` and the reader run on it):** the case has a `lumpedNuclearStructure` WITHOUT `kappaMatrix`; the refusal applies only to a `kappaMatrix != 0` variant. (The round-80 "Not done" bullet is corrected below.)
* The coupled-patch `fvc::laplacian` is therefore exercised only by VARIANTS (`scripts/make_msr1d_thermal_kappa_r81.py`, applied as text to both runs): **`kcore`**: the core's model with `nodeMatrix 0; kappaMatrix 30;` (graphite 30 W/m/K, the tutorial's own comment); the core (cells 107-266) does not touch the seam (cells 0 and 639), so the cyclic branch contributes exactly 0; **`kseam`**: `kcore` plus a second `lumpedNuclearStructure` region on `ColdLeg` (cells 0-106 and 587-639, the zone that holds BOTH seam cells; `volumeFraction 0.1`, `Dh 0.02`, `powerDensity 1e6`, the core's node data, `kappaMatrix 30`, `constant` htc 1e4): the variant whose seam faces carry a non-zero `snGrad(Tmatrix)`. Neither is a shipped case.
* Upstream, read (ESI v2506): `gaussLaplacianScheme::fvcLaplacian(vf)` = `fvc::div(tsnGradScheme_().snGrad(vf)*mesh.magSf())` (`gaussLaplacianScheme.C:139-154`); `snGradScheme::snGrad` (`snGradScheme.C:92-150`): internal `deltaCoeffs (N - P)`; a COUPLED patch `pvf.snGrad(tdeltaCoeffs().boundaryField()[patchi])` = `coupledFvPatchField::snGrad(deltaCoeffs)` = `deltaCoeffs (patchNeighbourField - patchInternalField)` (`coupledFvPatchField.C:112-120`), a non-coupled patch its own `snGrad()` (0 for `zeroGradient`); `uncorrectedSnGrad::deltaCoeffs` = `nonOrthDeltaCoeffs` (`uncorrectedSnGrad.H:113-119`; on a cyclic patch `1/max(nf & delta, 0.05 |delta|)`, `delta = ddi - dni`); `fvc::div(ssf)` = `surfaceIntegrate` (`fvcSurfaceIntegrate.C:45-78`): internal faces to owner (+) and neighbour (-), then every boundary face to its `faceCells` in patch order, then `/= V`. `patchNeighbourField` reads the partner's INTERNAL cells, so computing `fvc::laplacian(Tmatrix_)` before `Tmatrix_.correctBoundaryConditions()` (`lumpedNuclearStructure.C:444-446`) does not matter on the seam.
* Searched the port first: `radial_power::fvc_laplacian_uncorrected` (gh:#1879, internal faces only; its doc says boundary faces contribute 0, true for `zeroGradient`/`wedge`/`empty`, not for `cyclic`); `fv::sn_grad` already has the coupled `delta (N - P)` form (round 80); `Geometry::delta` on a cyclic face is the `cyclicFvPatch` `nonOrthDeltaCoeffs` (round 80). The new function reuses both; the old one is kept unchanged for non-cyclic meshes.
* Other differences of the thermal case from `1D_MSR` (all already read by the port, probe above): `laminar` (no `k`/`epsilon`/wall functions: the round-80 first difference, PETIR's `pow` in the `epsilon` wall function, is absent); `NusseltReynoldsPrandtlPower` htc on `core` (`0.023 Re^0.8 Pr^0.4`: two `pow`s per cell per step) and `constant` 1.85e4 on `hx`; `ReynoldsPower` drag on `hx:core`; pump `momentumSource (0 0 50000)`; `p_rgh` `GAMG` tolerance 1e-6, `p_rghFinal { $p_rgh; relTol 0; }`; `h` through the LAST-matching `".*"` (`PBiCGStab`/`diagonal`, tolerance 1e-5, `relTol 0.1`); `0/neutroRegion/secondaryPowerDensity` nonuniform (5e6 in the 160 core cells). The real steadyState stage: 7637 steps (loose, as shipped), 7557 (tight `pcg`); the transient 7712 steps; final `totalPower` 4.1525072e8 W (Alltest's `expectedAt` 415258000).

## Protocol

* **Thermal fluid stage**: `MSR_CASE_DIR=.../1D_thermalMSR_pointKinetics scripts/run_msr1d_fluid_r80.sh <dir> <tight|loose> <gamg|pcg> <full|first>` (round 80's script, now parameterised by the tutorial directory; an Allrun edit that only that tutorial's Allrun makes is applied when it does), references `refs/msr1d_r81_th_{first,full}_{tight_pcg,loose_gamg}*` (`MSR_FIELDS="U p p_rgh T alphaPhi htc"`, `MSR_EXTRA_FIELDS` = the structure's `Tmax`, `Tsurface`, `T.fuelAvForNeutronics`, `T.cladAvForNeutronics`); the port reads `cases/msr1d_thermal_root` (the shipped `rootCase` verbatim) with the same edits.
* **Variants**: the same with `MSR_VARIANT=core|seam` (tight `pcg`, `first` and `full`), references `refs/msr1d_r81_th_k{core,seam}_{first,full}_tight_pcg*` (+ `Tmatrix`).
* **Thermal transient**: `scripts/run_msr1d_steady_allrun_r81.sh` (Allrun's `setSteadyState` exactly; round 80 ran the same edits by hand) then `scripts/run_msr1d_transient_r80.sh <ss> <dir> <full|first>`; references `refs/msr1d_r81_th_tr_{first,full}*`, the start `refs/msr1d_r81_th_tr_start100.txt.gz` (the real `100` after the transient's `-initializeMappedFields`).

## Criteria (fixed now)

Round 80's, unchanged: **K1** every field (`U` on `max|U|`; here also the structure's `Tmax`, `Tsurface`, `T.fuelAvForNeutronics`) `<= 1e-9` relative to its max-norm at every written step of the tight runs; **K2** `deltaT` to the round-80 pin 1e-11; **K3** solves with upstream initial residual above 1e-10: residual to 1e-6, iterations within 1 (tight stagnating solves reported); **K4** `T` lines to 1e-9. Loose runs: reported, gated at 1e-6 at the last compared state. Transient: **T1-T4** of round 80 (runs; steps within 1 %; power, fluid `T`, `U` within 1e-3 at every written time; final power within 1e-3). First 60 transient steps: nothing over 1e-9. Chain: **W1** the port-written `100` holds every file the transient stage reads; **W2** every number of the port-written `100` (the fields of the real raw `100` that the port writes) within 5e-6 relative to the field's max-norm of the real one (both are 6-digit text: rounding a 1e-9 difference flips at most a last digit); **W3** the chained transient meets T1-T4 against `msr1d_r80_tr_full`; **W4** the chained port's `-initializeMappedFields` writes the same mapped `100/neutroRegion` fields as the real one, to 1e-9 of max-norm.

# Round 82 (gh:#1964, gh:#1956 under #1216): the four wrong or missing files of a port-written `onePhase` time directory; GAMG for the neutronics flux in multi-region `RegionSolvers` runs (one process-wide `pairGAMGAgglomeration::forward_`, re-agglomeration after `movePoints`)

> Research, education and V&V only. AI draft, unreviewed. Predictions and criteria below were written and committed BEFORE any port run against a real-binary number of this round. The real binary was started first on the new runs (allowed, as in round 81); none of its numbers had been read when this was written (only exit status and step counts).

## Part A (gh:#1964): read before any port code (GeN-Foam 652b3da)

* **`Re`**: `FSPair::correct` (`FSPair.C:337-345`) uses `structure_.Dh()`, whose constructor value is `SMALL` (`structure.C:74-84`, `dimensionedScalar("", dimLength, SMALL)`, 1e-15); only the cells of a `structureProperties` zone get the zone's `Dh` (`:300-317`). Outside every structure `Re = max(normalized |U| SMALL / nu, minRe) = minRe`. The port fills `Dh = 1` outside the structures (`one_phase_cc.rs`, `let mut dh = vec![1.0; n]`): the defect. Every other use of `Dh` outside a structure is multiplied by a coefficient that is 0 there (`porousKEpsilon.C:555-583`: `turbulenceIntensityCoeff_`, `turbulenceIntensityExp_`, `turbulenceLengthScaleCoeff_` default 0 outside the zones; the `max(.., SMALL)` length is `SMALL` either way) or is evaluated only in structure cells (drag, `htc`).
* **`alpha.passiveStructure`**: `alphapas_` is `READ_IF_PRESENT`, constructed as a copy of `*this` (`structure.C:138-148`) BEFORE the constructor body sets the zone fractions, i.e. `alpha.structure` as read from the start directory, else 0 (`phaseBase.C`: `dimensionedScalar("alpha", dimless, 0)`); in a zone with `passiveProperties` it is that dictionary's `volumeFraction` if present, else (only when `alpha.structure` was NOT read, `!alphaHeaderOk`) the zone's `volumeFraction` (`:430-460`). 1D_MSR has no `passiveProperties` and no `alpha.structure` at `t = 0`: 0 everywhere (`uniform 0`). 2D_fullCoupling has `passiveProperties` without `volumeFraction` on `zone0`: the zone fraction there (what the port writes today, its 84-file gate). `alphaRhoCppas_ = max(alphapas_ * rhoCp, 1e-69)` (`:741-748`).
* **`heatFlux.structure`**: `structure::correct(Hs*T.prevIter(), Hs)` (`EEqn_1p.H:100-104`) ends with `heatFlux_[c] = H[c]*Twall - HT[c]`, `Twall = Tact_[c]`, over `cells_`: EVERY cell of every structure zone (`structure.C:1057-1071`), after every power model's `correctT(Tact_)` (`fixedTemperature::correctT` = `temperatureUpdate`, then `Tact = T_`). The port sets it only on the radial models' cells (and returns early without a radial model). `heatFlux_` is `READ_IF_PRESENT`.
* **`alphaRhoMagU`**: `fluid::correctAlphaRhoMagU()` = `alpha*rho()*magU_` (`fluid.C:753-756`) runs inside `reconstructU_1p.H:21`, in the final non-orthogonal pass of each corrector, BEFORE `fluid_.magU() = mag(U)` (`pEqnf_1p.H:79-83`; `pEqn_1p.H:68-84` for `cellCenteredFaceReconstruction`): it takes the `magU_` of the PREVIOUS corrector (cells, and the `calculated` boundary `|U_b|`). The port tracks `magU_` of the cells only and refuses the file by name (`writes_alpha_rho_mag_u`).
* Searched: `update_re`, `structure_correct`, `PassiveStructure`, `FlowState::mag_u`, `written.rs` (all reused; the new code is the state they lack).

## Part B (gh:#1956): read before any port code (OpenFOAM-ESI v2506, GeN-Foam 652b3da)

* `GAMGAgglomeration::New(mesh, dict)` (`GAMGAgglomeration.C:313-338`): the mesh registry object, built at the FIRST `GAMG` solve on that mesh; if `requireUpdate_` is set it is checked out and rebuilt. `GAMGAgglomeration` is a `MeshObject<lduMesh, MoveableMeshObject, ..>` (`GAMGAgglomeration.H:90`); `fvMesh::movePoints` calls `meshObject::movePoints<lduMesh>` (`fvMesh.C:952-953`) -> `GAMGAgglomeration::movePoints()` sets `requireUpdate_` when `requiresUpdate()` (`updateInterval 1`: always; `:520-539`).
* `movePoints` is called by `deformMesh()` of every region listed in `meshDeformation` (`neutronics.C:360-408`, `thermalHydraulicsModel.C:385-420`, `thermoMechanics.C:355-390`); `GeN-Foam.C:193-197` runs `deformMesh(); correctPhysics();` per region in `regionSolvers` order each step; `multiPhysicsSolver` deforms every member first and again in each pass (round 75).
* `pairGAMGAgglomeration::forward_` (`pairGAMGAgglomeration.C:36`): ONE static of the process, toggled at every level attempted (`pairGAMGAgglomerate.C:333`). In a coupled run the start value of each build is set by the level counts of every earlier build, in solve order.
* The only shipped multi-region case with a neutronics `GAMG` block is `3D_SmallESFR` (`NewSolverVerification/legacySolver`, `_old`), commented out; its fluid `p_rgh` and thermo-mechanics `TStruct` already run `GAMG`, and its neutronics mesh moves every step (`meshDeformation neutroRegion disp`). 2D_fullCoupling has one `GAMG` region (`TStruct`), 1D_MSR and the MSFR coupled stages one (`p_rgh`): their forward state cannot change.
* Searched: `GamgSolveState` (fluid, two-phase, TM: one each, own `forward = true`), `gamg_solve_on_mesh` (neutronics, built per solve from `true`), `pair_agglomerate` (takes `&mut forward`), `RegionSolvers::{step, correct_multi_physics, deform_mesh}`, the refusal in `neutronics_diffusion_settings`. Reused; the new code is the shared state and its hand-over.

## Part B criteria (fixed now)

* **B-C1 tight**: per step `keff`, `power` `<= 1e-11` relative; fingerprints and full fields at the kept steps `<= 1e-9`; flux solve counts equal; iteration counts reported.
* **B-C2 as shipped**: per step `keff`, `power` `<= 1e-9` over the 20 steps; FLUX, `p_rgh`, TM iteration counts equal (reported per step where not).
* **B-C3 controls**: each control differs from the real as-shipped run by more than the default in at least one of `keff`, `power`, an iteration count, OR is shown inert by the level parities (then it does not test the piece, and that is recorded).
* **B-C4**: earlier GAMG comparisons in coupled runs do not move except through the shared state; any moved number listed old -> new and judged against the real binary.

**Why `dgdt` and `p_rgh` cannot be made byte-identical in the chain (explained, not fixed):** both are near-zero values (`dgdt ~ 1e-16`, the six `p_rgh` gradients ~ 1e-22) whose digits are round-off of the state; the 8340-step `steadyState` is not bit-identical (round 80: `p` 2.7e-12) because of gh:#1963 (PETIR `pow` against the platform `pow`, 1 ulp at step 6). The 17-digit run shows their operation order is upstream's: `dgdt` is bit-identical for 25 steps, 20 steps past the first `pow` ulp. Reaching byte-identity needs gh:#1963 (a maintainer decision: the workspace rule is PETIR `RealMath`).

**Level parities (read from the port's `forward_` after each step and the two controls):** the fluid `p_rgh` build (first, from `true`) leaves `false` (an ODD number of levels attempted), so upstream's neutronics agglomeration starts from `false`: the `shared_off` control, which starts it from `true`, misses by 4e-6 at the FIRST step while the default matches to 1e-16. The neutronics rebuild after each `deformMesh` and the TM build leave `forward_` unchanged (`false` after every step: EVEN counts), so the rebuild after mesh motion does not change `forward_` on this case and the `reagg_off` control is inert (identical numbers): the rebuild path runs every step but its `forward_` bookkeeping is NOT tested by this case (B-C3: recorded as inert). The moved `Sf` enters every rebuild in both forms.

### Earlier comparisons re-run (B-C4): what moved

The fluid builds first and starts at `true` as before. On the round 74 ESFR case (PCG neutronics) the fluid build creates 6 levels (7 attempted: odd), so the TM `TStruct` build now starts at `false` and creates 8 levels (`GamgSolveState` read after step 1 by the test), where every earlier round started it at `true`. That a reversed pairing order leaves every TM residual and iteration count unchanged on this mesh was not examined further (filed on gh:#1966). In the loose run it is in the `relTol 1e-3` stopping flips of the TM solves from step ~100 (round 75 Part A), which are noise-floor discontinuities (round 67). ## Part B (gh:#1967): read before any port code (GeN-Foam 652b3da)

* `structure.C:74-84`: `Dh_` constructed `SMALL`; `:300-317` the zone `Dh` on the zone cells only. The twoPhase reader filled `Dh = 1` outside the zones (`case.rs`, `vec![1.0; n]`): the round 82 form. Where `structure_.Dh()` enters twoPhase physics outside a zone: `FSPair::correct` `Re = max(normalized |U| Dh/nu, minRe)` (`FSPair.C:337-345`, written `Re.<fluid>.structure`), `fluidDiameterModel::correctField` (`Dh_fluid = Dhs` where the dispersion is 0, so the FF pair's dispersed/continuous diameters), the FS drag `0.5/Dh` (only where a drag model is set). The shipped twoPhase cases the port runs (1D_boiling, PSBT, CHF, 2D_voidMotionNoPhaseChange) have every cell in a `structureProperties` zone (cellZones counted), so no shipped number can move; `2D_KNS37-L22` (cellZone `pipe`, 70 cells, no structure) is not run by the port.
* `structure.C:1057-1071`: `heatFlux_ = H Twall - HT`, `Twall = Tact`, over `cells_` (every zone), at the end of `structure::correct(H1s T1 + H2s T2, H1s + H2s)` (`EEqns_2p.H:331`). The port set it only on the radial models' cells (`radial_structure_correct`): the `fixedPower` cells of the shipped 1D_boiling kept 0. Written only: `Shah`/`Gorenflo` `useExplicitHeatFlux true` (the only readers, `ShahFSHeatTransferCoefficient.C:95`) are refused by name.
* `structure.C:138-148`, `:430-460`: `alphapas_` = `alpha.structure` as constructed (read from the start directory, else 0), then the passive zones' `volumeFraction`. The twoPhase reader refuses `passiveProperties` (only `volumeFraction`/`Dh`/`powerModel` keys) and IGNORED a start-directory `alpha.structure` (upstream then uses it INSTEAD of the zone fractions, `alphaHeaderOk`); no shipped twoPhase case has one. So `alpha.passiveStructure` is 0 everywhere in every case the port accepts; it is written-only and the port has no twoPhase writer. Port: `Structure::alpha_passive` (0), and a start-directory `alpha.structure` refused by name.
* Port (new code): `dh = SMALL` outside the zones; `Structure::cells` (`with_cells`, dictionary order); `TwoPhaseSolver::update_structure_heat_flux` over the non-radial structure cells (the radial ones keep their round 41 value, the same expression).

### Round 83 addendum A (written after the first port runs of `c0`-`c5` and `b0`-`b5`, the `q0`/`q1` gates, and BEFORE any port run with the change below or of `c6`/`k*`)

**Finding (from the `b*` solve logs):** in every step the LAST `h.liquid` solve of upstream's log does not follow the variant's controls (`b1`, `relTol 0.1`: 3 iterations where the port does 1; `b5`, `nSweeps -2`: a non-zero residual): `customPimpleControl::loop` calls `mesh.data().setFinalIteration(true)` in the outer iteration whose criteria are met (`customPimpleControl.C:250-257`), and `fvMatrix::solve` then selects `h.liquidFinal`, which in `b*` resolves to the catch-all `".*"` (`PBiCGStab`). The port selected the non-Final entry in every iteration, in `two_phase` (`h`, and `k`/`epsilon`) and in `one_phase_fc` (`h`); every shipped case resolves both to the same entry, so no shipped number can move. The `c*` variants carry identical `h`/`hFinal` entries and cannot see it. **Change (before its first run):** `TwoPhaseControls::{h_pbicgstab_final, h_smooth_final}`, `PorousKEpsilon2PhaseCorrected::{k_solver_final, epsilon_solver_final}`, `OnePhaseFcControls::{h_pbicgstab_final, h_smooth_final}`, selected in the iteration the port flags converged (`pimple_converged`, the same flag). **Added variant (before its real run):** `c6` = `c1` without the `hFinal` entry. # Round 84 (gh:#1938, gh:#1954 under #1216; maintainer 2026-11-27: "Port genfoam exhaustively", "Match all upstream"): the written-state limits left after round 69, and the baffle-less mesh at later write times

> Research, education and V&V only. AI draft, not human-reviewed. Predictions and criteria below were written and committed BEFORE any port run against a real-binary number of this round. The real binary WAS run first (allowed by the protocol, as in rounds 79 and 81); its output was packed into references; what was read of it is listed under "Read before any port code" and nothing else of it entered a criterion.

## Read before any port code (2026-11-28, OpenFOAM-ESI v2506, GeN-Foam 652b3da, and the real runs of this round)

* **`timeStep` write rule.** `Time::setControls` reads `index` of `<startTime>/uniform/time` into `startTimeIndex_` and sets `timeIndex_ = startTimeIndex_` (`Time.C:304-306`); `Time::operator++` writes when `!(timeIndex_ % label(writeInterval_))` (`:1111-1112`). The port's clock counted `time_index % n` from 0 (round 69 limit). Real run `sh_ts9`/`pk_ts9` (`writeControl timeStep; writeInterval 9` on the round 69 transients, start `100`, `index 476`): written indices 477, 486, 495, ... (steps 1, 10, 19, ...; 476 % 9 = 8). `adjustableRunTime` counts from `startTime_` (`:1117-1128`), as the port already does.
* **Time-name precision (a finding of the real runs, not named in gh:#1938).** `timePrecision` is READ from `controlDict` (2D_fullCoupling ships `8`; the port wrote names at a fixed 6) and GROWS at a write time: `Time.C:1189-1225` re-reads the new name and adds digits while `|name - oldTime - deltaT| > max(min(10^-precision, 0.1 deltaT), SMALL)`, up to `maxPrecision_ = 3 - log10(SMALL) = 18` (`:83`). The real `sh_ts9` log: "Increased the timePrecision from 8 to 9 ... at time 100.000001", 9 -> 12, 12 -> 15, 15 -> 17; its directories are named `100.000001`, `100.000025959`, `100.00015474`, ... At startup `setControls` (`:193-255`) raises the precision when the start directory is named at a larger one. Ported: `region_solvers::time_name::TimeName` (`no_std`), `RegionSolvers::time_directory_name`, `time_precision`.
* **`alphaRhoMagU` under reconstruction.** Round 82 ported `correctAlphaRhoMagU()` (`reconstructU_1p.H:21`) in BOTH reconstructing momentum modes (`flow.rs` for `cellCenteredFaceReconstruction`, `face_centered.rs`) and lifted the by-name refusal; its comparison was 1D_MSR, which is `faceCentered`. No shipped coupled case with a writer comparison selects `cellCenteredFaceReconstruction` (only 2D_FFTF does). Not compared in this round (stated, filed below).
* **`polyTopoChange` renumbering.** Since round 78 the port BUILDS every baffle-less mesh (`build_baffle_less`, `merge_duplicate_faces`: `getFaceOrder` on every internal face, not only merged ones). What was left was the writer's precondition `check_unchanged_by_removal`, which also refused an UNUSED point: but `polyTopoChange::compact` with `orderPoints = false` keeps every point not removed (`polyTopoChange.C:983-995`); upstream does not drop it. Real variants (`scripts/make_fc_mesh_variant_r84.py`, one step of the 2D_fullCoupling steady stage, `scripts/run_fc_mesh_variants_r84.sh`): **`swap`** (internal faces 0 and 1 of the fluid mesh exchanged: out of upper-triangular order): the real baffle-less copy IS renumbered back (its `faces`/`owner`/`neighbour` equal the `base` run's, byte for byte); **`unused`** (one unused point appended): the real copy keeps it (`nPoints:351`).
* **Zones at later write times (gh:#1954).** `addZones` (`meshHandler.C:483-527`) runs AFTER `removeBaffles` wrote the start directory, and copies the region mesh's zones UNRENUMBERED. Real 3D_SmallESFR_old as shipped (`scripts/run_esfr_baffle_less_r84.sh`: steady 242 s, transient 137 s, both exit 0): `ss/200` and `tr/210` hold the same eight baffle-less files apart from `location` (7 cell zones with the `meta` names; 2 face zones `walls` (empty) and `baffleFaces`, 21 252 labels 49 728 .. 70 979 on a 60 354-face mesh, flip map of 0s and 1s, as the baffled mesh's file); `pointZones` `0()`. `sets/duplicateFaces` is in the START directories only (`ss/0`, `tr/200`; 2D_fullCoupling `100` after `-initializeMappedFields`: `0()`): `findBaffles` writes it as a `labelHashSet` (`mergeOrSplitBaffles.C:215-231`), whose iteration order is ESI's `HashTable` (identity hash of `label`, power-of-two buckets, insertion at the head, doubling at 0.8 load): the real ESFR set starts at 65 536 and ends at 65 535. Ported: `PolyMeshOut::{face_zones, duplicate_face_set, duplicate_faces_file}`, `FaceZoneOut`, `parse_face_zones_out`, `label_hash_set_order`, `face_set_text`, `RegionSolvers::baffle_less_start_files`.
* **`latticeMap`** (`common/latticeMap`, 315 lines) is not used by `removeBaffles` or by any ported path; it is not ported in this round (filed).
* **R0 (reproducibility of the real runs, checked before any port run):** this round's real `sh/100` (after `-initializeMappedFields`), `sh/110` and `pk/110` are byte-identical to round 66's `fc_start100_r66` and round 69's `fc_{sh,pk}_written110_r69` (packed and compared with `cmp`).

## Protocol

* References (refs submodule): `fc_{sh,pk}_written120_200_r84.txt.gz` (the real `120 ... 200` of the round 69 SH and PK transients, `writeControl adjustableRunTime; writeInterval 10`, 83 and 72 files per directory); `fc_{sh,pk}_ts9_write_times_r84.txt` (every written directory name and its `uniform/time` `index`, `writeInterval 9`) and `fc_{sh,pk}_ts9_written_r84.txt.gz` (the 2nd, 3rd, 4th and last written directories); `fc_r84_mesh_{base,swap,unused}.txt.gz` (`0/` and `1/fluidRegion.baffleLess`); `esfr_r84_baffleless_later.txt.gz` (`210/fluidRegion.baffleLess/polyMesh`, 8 files, and `200/.../sets/duplicateFaces`).
* Port: `RegionSolvers::read` on the staged transient with the REAL written `100` (round 69's `stage_from_files`), run to `endTime 200`, `written_files` at every write time, compared by round 69's `compare_directory` (17 digits).

## Criteria (fixed now)

* **L1** (SH and PK, every write time `120 ... 200`): the port reaches each write time at `|t - T| <= 1e-12` with the real step count (the written `index`); file lists equal (83 / 72); 0 skeleton differences; every number `<= 1e-9` of its file's maximum, except `dgdt` (round 69's noise gate: both `max|dgdt| < 1e-12`, pointwise reported) and `neutroRegion/meshPhi` (equal to the real one, round 69 addendum A).
